4744                // Timestamp: 8 bytes, i64 milliseconds big-endian (NO length prefix, per Cassandra spec)
4745                if offset + 8 > data.len() {
4746                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4747                        "Cell '{}': need 8 bytes for timestamp, only {} available",
4748                        column.name,
4749                        data.len() - offset
4750                    )));
4751                }
4752                let millis = i64::from_be_bytes([
4753                    data[offset],
4754                    data[offset + 1],
4755                    data[offset + 2],
4756                    data[offset + 3],
4757                    data[offset + 4],
4758                    data[offset + 5],
4759                    data[offset + 6],
4760                    data[offset + 7],
4761                ]);
4762                offset += 8;
4763                Value::Timestamp(millis)
4764            }
4765
4766            "date" => {
4767                // Date: [VInt len=4][i32 BE days]
4768                if offset >= data.len() {
4769                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4770                        "Cell '{}': unexpected end at date length",
4771                        column.name
4772                    )));
4773                }
4774
4775                let (remaining, date_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
4776                    Error::corruption(format!(
4777                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse date length as VInt: {:?}",
4778                        column.name, e
4779                    ))
4780                })?;
4781                let date_len = date_len as usize;
4782                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
4783                offset += bytes_consumed;
4784
4785                if date_len != 4 {
4786                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4787                        "Cell '{}': expected date length 4, got {}",
4788                        column.name, date_len
4789                    )));
4790                }
4791
4792                if offset + 4 > data.len() {
4793                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4794                        "Cell '{}': need 4 bytes for date, only {} available",
4795                        column.name,
4796                        data.len() - offset
4797                    )));
4798                }
4799
4800                let stored = u32::from_be_bytes([
4801                    data[offset],
4802                    data[offset + 1],
4803                    data[offset + 2],
4804                    data[offset + 3],
4805                ]);
4806                offset += 4;
4807                // Cassandra DATE: 4-byte unsigned int with Integer.MIN_VALUE offset
4808                let days_since_epoch = stored.wrapping_add(i32::MIN as u32) as i32;
4809                Value::Date(days_since_epoch)
4810            }
4811
4812            "duration" => {
4813                // Duration: [VInt len][months VInt][days VInt][nanos VInt]
4814                // Format: Variable-length encoding with 3 VInt components
4815                if offset >= data.len() {
4816                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4817                        "Cell '{}': unexpected end at duration length",
4818                        column.name
4819                    )));
4820                }
4821
4822                let (remaining, duration_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
4823                    Error::corruption(format!(
4824                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse duration length as VInt: {:?}",
4825                        column.name, e
4826                    ))
4827                })?;
4828                let duration_len = duration_len as usize;
4829                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
4830                offset += bytes_consumed;
4831
4832                if offset + duration_len > data.len() {
4833                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4834                        "Cell '{}': need {} bytes for duration, only {} available",
4835                        column.name,
4836                        duration_len,
4837                        data.len() - offset
4838                    )));
4839                }
4840
4841                // Parse three VInt components from the duration_len bytes
4842                let duration_bytes = &data[offset..offset + duration_len];
4843
4844                // Parse months (signed VInt)
4845                let (remaining, months) = parse_vint(duration_bytes).map_err(|e| {
4846                    Error::corruption(format!(
4847                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse duration months: {:?}",
4848                        column.name, e
4849                    ))
4850                })?;
4851                let pos = duration_bytes.len() - remaining.len();
4852
4853                // Parse days (signed VInt)
4854                let (remaining, days) = parse_vint(&duration_bytes[pos..]).map_err(|e| {
4855                    Error::corruption(format!(
4856                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse duration days: {:?}",
4857                        column.name, e
4858                    ))
4859                })?;
4860                let pos = duration_bytes.len() - remaining.len();
4861
4862                // Parse nanoseconds (signed VInt)
4863                let (remaining, nanos) = parse_vint(&duration_bytes[pos..]).map_err(|e| {
4864                    Error::corruption(format!(
4865                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse duration nanos: {:?}",
4866                        column.name, e
4867                    ))
4868                })?;
4869
4870                // Verify we consumed all duration bytes
4871                if !remaining.is_empty() {
4872                    warn!(
4873                        "V5CompressedLegacy: Duration '{}' has {} extra bytes after parsing",
4874                        column.name,
4875                        remaining.len()
4876                    );
4877                }
4878
4879                offset += duration_len;
4880                Value::Duration {
4881                    months: months as i32,
4882                    days: days as i32,
4883                    nanos,
4884                }
4885            }
4886
4887            "float" => {
4888                // Float: 4 bytes, f32 big-endian (NO length prefix, fixed size)
4889                if offset + 4 > data.len() {
4890                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4891                        "Cell '{}': need 4 bytes for float, only {} available",
4892                        column.name,
4893                        data.len() - offset
4894                    )));
4895                }
4896
4897                let val = f32::from_be_bytes([
4898                    data[offset],
4899                    data[offset + 1],
4900                    data[offset + 2],
4901                    data[offset + 3],
4902                ]);
4903                offset += 4;
4904                Value::Float(val as f64) // Convert f32 to f64 for storage
4905            }
4906
4907            "smallint" | "short" => {
4908                // SmallInt: [VInt len=2][i16 BE]
4909                if offset >= data.len() {
4910                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4911                        "Cell '{}': unexpected end at smallint length",
4912                        column.name
4913                    )));
4914                }
4915
4916                let (remaining, len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
4917                    Error::corruption(format!(
4918                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse smallint length as VInt: {:?}",
4919                        column.name, e
4920                    ))
4921                })?;
4922                let len = len as usize;
4923                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
4924                offset += bytes_consumed;
4925
4926                if len != 2 {
4927                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4928                        "Cell '{}': expected smallint length 2, got {}",
4929                        column.name, len
4930                    )));
4931                }
4932
4933                if offset + 2 > data.len() {
4934                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4935                        "Cell '{}': need 2 bytes for smallint, only {} available",
4936                        column.name,
4937                        data.len() - offset
4938                    )));
4939                }
4940
4941                let val = i16::from_be_bytes([data[offset], data[offset + 1]]);
4942                offset += 2;
4943                Value::SmallInt(val)
4944            }
4945
4946            "tinyint" | "byte" => {
4947                // TinyInt: [VInt len=1][i8]
4948                if offset >= data.len() {
4949                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4950                        "Cell '{}': unexpected end at tinyint length",
4951                        column.name
4952                    )));
4953                }
4954
4955                let (remaining, len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
4956                    Error::corruption(format!(
4957                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse tinyint length as VInt: {:?}",
4958                        column.name, e
4959                    ))
4960                })?;
4961                let len = len as usize;
4962                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
4963                offset += bytes_consumed;
4964
4965                if len != 1 {
4966                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4967                        "Cell '{}': expected tinyint length 1, got {}",
4968                        column.name, len
4969                    )));
4970                }
4971
4972                if offset >= data.len() {
4973                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4974                        "Cell '{}': need 1 byte for tinyint, only {} available",
4975                        column.name,
4976                        data.len() - offset
4977                    )));
4978                }
4979
4980                let val = data[offset] as i8;
4981                offset += 1;
4982                Value::TinyInt(val)
4983            }
4984
4985            "time" => {
4986                // Time: [VInt len=8][i64 BE nanoseconds since midnight]
4987                if offset >= data.len() {
4988                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
4989                        "Cell '{}': unexpected end at time length",
4990                        column.name
4991                    )));
4992                }
4993                let (remaining, time_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
4994                    Error::corruption(format!(
4995                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse time length as VInt: {:?}",
4996                        column.name, e
4997                    ))
4998                })?;
4999                let time_len = time_len as usize;
5000                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
5001                offset += bytes_consumed;
5002                if time_len != 8 {
5003                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5004                        "Cell '{}': expected time length 8, got {}",
5005                        column.name, time_len
5006                    )));
5007                }
5008                if offset + 8 > data.len() {
5009                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5010                        "Cell '{}': need 8 bytes for time value, only {} available",
5011                        column.name,
5012                        data.len() - offset
5013                    )));
5014                }
5015                let nanos = i64::from_be_bytes([
5016                    data[offset],
5017                    data[offset + 1],
5018                    data[offset + 2],
5019                    data[offset + 3],
5020                    data[offset + 4],
5021                    data[offset + 5],
5022                    data[offset + 6],
5023                    data[offset + 7],
5024                ]);
5025                offset += 8;
5026                Value::Time(nanos)
5027            }
5028
5029            "inet" => {
5030                // Inet: [VInt len][address bytes] (len is 4 for IPv4, 16 for IPv6)
5031                if offset >= data.len() {
5032                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5033                        "Cell '{}': unexpected end at inet length",
5034                        column.name
5035                    )));
5036                }
5037
5038                let (remaining, len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
5039                    Error::corruption(format!(
5040                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse inet length as VInt: {:?}",
5041                        column.name, e
5042                    ))
5043                })?;
5044                let len = len as usize;
5045                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
5046                offset += bytes_consumed;
5047
5048                if len != 4 && len != 16 {
5049                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5050                        "Cell '{}': invalid inet length {}, expected 4 or 16",
5051                        column.name, len
5052                    )));
5053                }
5054
5055                if offset + len > data.len() {
5056                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5057                        "Cell '{}': need {} bytes for inet, only {} available",
5058                        column.name,
5059                        len,
5060                        data.len() - offset
5061                    )));
5062                }
5063
5064                let bytes = data[offset..offset + len].to_vec();
5065                offset += len;
5066                Value::Inet(bytes)
5067            }
5068
5069            // Complex types: frozen, tuple, UDT
5070            type_str if type_str.starts_with("frozen<") => {
5071                // Frozen types: unwrap inner type and route to appropriate parser
5072                let inner_type = self.extract_frozen_inner_type(type_str)?;
5073
5074                log::debug!(
5075                    "V5CompressedLegacy: Parsing frozen type '{}' -> inner type '{}'",
5076                    type_str,
5077                    inner_type
5078                );
5079
5080                // Route to appropriate frozen collection parser
5081                let (inner_value, new_offset) = if inner_type.starts_with("list<") {
5082                    let element_type = self.extract_collection_element_type(&inner_type, "list")?;
5083                    self.parse_frozen_list_value(data, offset, &element_type, column, _reader)?
5084                } else if inner_type.starts_with("set<") {
5085                    let element_type = self.extract_collection_element_type(&inner_type, "set")?;
5086                    self.parse_frozen_set_value(data, offset, &element_type, column, _reader)?
5087                } else if inner_type.starts_with("map<") {
5088                    let (key_type, value_type) = self.extract_map_types(&inner_type)?;
5089                    self.parse_frozen_map_value(
5090                        data,
5091                        offset,
5092                        &key_type,
5093                        &value_type,
5094                        column,
5095                        _reader,
5096                    )?
5097                } else if Self::is_udt_type(&column.data_type) {
5098                    // Frozen UDT - parse using UDT parser
5099                    // The column.data_type contains the full Cassandra type string including UserType
5100                    log::debug!(
5101                        "V5CompressedLegacy: Parsing frozen UDT column '{}' type='{}'",
5102                        column.name,
5103                        column.data_type
5104                    );
5105
5106                    // Parse UDT definition from the type string
5107                    let udt_def = Self::parse_udt_type_definition(&column.data_type)?;
5108
5109                    // First read the VInt-prefixed blob length
5110                    let (remaining, blob_len_raw) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
5111                        Error::corruption(format!(
5112                            "Frozen UDT '{}': failed to parse blob length: {:?}",
5113                            column.name, e
5114                        ))
5115                    })?;
5116                    if blob_len_raw > MAX_CELL_VALUE_LENGTH {
5117                        return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5118                            "Frozen UDT '{}': blob_len {} exceeds maximum {}",
5119                            column.name, blob_len_raw, MAX_CELL_VALUE_LENGTH
5120                        )));
5121                    }
5122                    let blob_len = blob_len_raw as usize;
5123                    let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
5124                    offset += bytes_consumed;
5125
5126                    if offset + blob_len > data.len() {
5127                        return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5128                            "Frozen UDT '{}': need {} bytes but only {} available",
5129                            column.name,
5130                            blob_len,
5131                            data.len() - offset
5132                        )));
5133                    }
5134
5135                    // Parse UDT value from the blob
5136                    let udt_data = &data[offset..offset + blob_len];
5137                    let (udt_value, _) =
5138                        self.parse_udt_value(udt_data, 0, &udt_def, column, _reader)?;
5139                    offset += blob_len;
5140
5141                    (udt_value, offset)
5142                } else if let Some(udt_def) = self
5143                    .udt_registry
5144                    .as_ref()
5145                    .and_then(|reg| reg.get_udt(&self.keyspace, &inner_type).cloned())
5146                {
5147                    // frozen<short_udt_name>: look up the concrete UDT definition in the
5148                    // registry (Issue #502).  This handles type strings like
5149                    // `frozen<person>` where "person" is a registered UDT rather than a
5150                    // collection or a full marshal-format UserType string.
5151                    log::debug!(
5152                        "V5CompressedLegacy: Resolving frozen UDT '{}' via registry for column '{}'",
5153                        inner_type,
5154                        column.name,
5155                    );
5156
5157                    // Read VUInt-prefixed blob length (same framing as tuple and
5158                    // marshal-format UDT cells).
5159                    let (remaining, blob_len_raw) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
5160                        Error::corruption(format!(
5161                            "Frozen UDT '{}' (column '{}'): failed to parse blob length: {:?}",
5162                            inner_type, column.name, e
5163                        ))
5164                    })?;
5165                    if blob_len_raw > MAX_CELL_VALUE_LENGTH {
5166                        return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5167                            "Frozen UDT '{}' (column '{}'): blob_len {} exceeds maximum {}",
5168                            inner_type, column.name, blob_len_raw, MAX_CELL_VALUE_LENGTH
5169                        )));
5170                    }
5171                    let blob_len = blob_len_raw as usize;
5172                    let len_bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
5173                    offset += len_bytes_consumed;
5174
5175                    if offset + blob_len > data.len() {
5176                        return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5177                            "Frozen UDT '{}' (column '{}'): need {} bytes but only {} available",
5178                            inner_type,
5179                            column.name,
5180                            blob_len,
5181                            data.len() - offset
5182                        )));
5183                    }
5184
5185                    let udt_data = &data[offset..offset + blob_len];
5186                    let (udt_value, _) =
5187                        self.parse_udt_value(udt_data, 0, &udt_def, column, _reader)?;
5188                    offset += blob_len;
5189
5190                    (udt_value, offset)
5191                } else {
5192                    // Detect bare identifiers that look like unregistered UDT names.
5193                    // A bare identifier has no '<' (not a container or tuple) and does not
5194                    // match any known CQL primitive type.  If we reach this branch with
5195                    // such an identifier it means the UDT was not in the registry — return
5196                    // an actionable schema error rather than silently producing a Blob.
5197                    //
5198                    // Legitimate fall-through types handled below:
5199                    //   • tuple<...>  (contains '<')
5200                    //   • known primitives: int, text, uuid, boolean, blob, float, double,
5201                    //     decimal, varint, bigint, counter, timestamp, date, time, duration,
5202                    //     inet, smallint, tinyint, varchar, ascii, timeuuid
5203                    const KNOWN_PRIMITIVES: &[&str] = &[
5204                        "int",
5205                        "bigint",
5206                        "counter",
5207                        "smallint",
5208                        "tinyint",
5209                        "text",
5210                        "varchar",
5211                        "ascii",
5212                        "uuid",
5213                        "timeuuid",
5214                        "boolean",
5215                        "blob",
5216                        "float",
5217                        "double",
5218                        "decimal",
5219                        "varint",
5220                        "timestamp",
5221                        "date",
5222                        "time",
5223                        "duration",
5224                        "inet",
5225                    ];
5226                    let is_container = inner_type.contains('<');
5227                    let is_primitive = KNOWN_PRIMITIVES.contains(&inner_type.as_str());
5228                    if !is_container && !is_primitive {
5229                        // Bare identifier that is neither a container nor a primitive —
5230                        // this is an unregistered UDT name.
5231                        return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5232                            "frozen<{inner}>: UDT '{inner}' not found in registry for keyspace '{}'; \
5233                             register it before reading",
5234                            self.keyspace,
5235                            inner = inner_type,
5236                        )));
5237                    }
5238                    // Non-collection / primitive frozen type — recurse normally.
5239                    // The recursive call now returns 4 elements; we only need value + offset.
5240                    let mut inner_column = column.clone();
5241                    inner_column.data_type = inner_type.clone();
5242                    let (inner_val, _inner_ts, _inner_exp, inner_off) =
5243                        self.parse_cell_value_schema_order(data, offset, &inner_column, _reader)?;
5244                    (inner_val, inner_off)
5245                };
5246
5247                offset = new_offset;
5248
5249                // Wrap in Frozen
5250                Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
5251            }
5252
5253            type_str if type_str.starts_with("tuple<") => {
5254                // Tuple types: parse fixed number of elements
5255                self.parse_tuple_value(data, &mut offset, type_str, column, _reader)?
5256            }
5257
5258            // Non-frozen collections: list, set, map
5259            // TODO(Issue #162, Task 3): Multi-cell collection parsing
5260            //
5261            // Collections in V5CompressedLegacy are stored as MULTIPLE CELLS with path identifiers,
5262            // NOT as single blob values. The current single-cell parser cannot handle this.
5263            //
5264            // Format (from sstabledump analysis):
5265            //   {"name": "scores", "deletion_info": {...}},  // Collection tombstone
5266            //   {"name": "scores", "path": ["uuid1"], "value": 23},  // Element 1
5267            //   {"name": "scores", "path": ["uuid2"], "value": 99},  // Element 2
5268            //
5269            // Required implementation:
5270            //   1. Parse cell path (clustering key bytes) for each collection element
5271            //   2. Detect collection tombstone cell (has deletion_info, no path/value)
5272            //   3. Read N element cells (each with path + value)
5273            //   4. Aggregate elements into Value::List/Set/Map based on column type
5274            //   5. Handle different path encodings:
5275            //      - list<T>: path is UUID bytes (timeuuid for ordering)
5276            //      - set<T>: path is serialized element value (key), value is empty
5277            //      - map<K,V>: path is serialized key, value is serialized value
5278            //
5279            // This is a fundamental architectural change requiring cell-level parsing
5280            // before column-level aggregation. For now, return stub to unblock downstream work.
5281            type_str
5282                if type_str.starts_with("list<")
5283                    || type_str.starts_with("set<")
5284                    || type_str.starts_with("map<") =>
5285            {
5286                warn!(
5287                    "V5CompressedLegacy: Non-frozen collection '{}' type '{}' requires multi-cell parsing (not yet implemented). \
5288                     Collections are stored as multiple cells with path identifiers, requiring cell-level aggregation. \
5289                     Returning empty collection as placeholder. See Issue #162 Task 3 for implementation plan.",
5290                    column.name, column.data_type
5291                );
5292
5293                // Return empty collection based on type
5294                if type_str.starts_with("list<") {
5295                    Value::List(Vec::new())
5296                } else if type_str.starts_with("set<") {
5297                    Value::Set(Vec::new())
5298                } else {
5299                    Value::Map(Vec::new())
5300                }
5301            }
5302
5303            // TODO(Issue #162): UDT parsing requires schema registry access
5304            // For now, UDTs fall through to blob. Future implementation will:
5305            // - Extract UDT name from type_str
5306            // - Look up UDT definition in schema registry
5307            // - Parse fields according to UDT schema
5308            // - Return Value::Udt(UdtValue)
5309
5310            // Default: treat as VInt-length-prefixed blob
5311            // CRITICAL: V5CompressedLegacy format uses VInt encoding for blob/bytes lengths,
5312            // NOT simple u8 length prefix. This allows blobs > 255 bytes.
5313            _ => {
5314                if offset >= data.len() {
5315                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5316                        "Cell '{}': unexpected end at blob length (type: {})",
5317                        column.name, column.data_type
5318                    )));
5319                }
5320
5321                // Parse blob length as unsigned VInt (can be > 255 bytes)
5322                let (remaining, blob_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
5323                    Error::corruption(format!(
5324                        "Cell '{}': failed to parse blob length as VInt: {:?}",
5325                        column.name, e
5326                    ))
5327                })?;
5328                let blob_len = blob_len as usize;
5329                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
5330                offset += bytes_consumed;
5331
5332                if offset + blob_len > data.len() {
5333                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5334                        "Cell '{}': need {} bytes for blob, only {} available (type: {})",
5335                        column.name,
5336                        blob_len,
5337                        data.len() - offset,
5338                        column.data_type
5339                    )));
5340                }
5341
5342                let blob_bytes = data[offset..offset + blob_len].to_vec();
5343                offset += blob_len;
5344                Value::Blob(blob_bytes)
5345            }
5346        };
5347
5348        Ok((value, cell_timestamp, cell_expiration, offset))
5349    }
5350
5351    /// Extract inner type from frozen<T> type string
5352    fn extract_frozen_inner_type(&self, type_str: &str) -> Result<String> {
5353        if !type_str.starts_with("frozen<") || !type_str.ends_with('>') {
5354            return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5355                "Invalid frozen type format: {}",
5356                type_str
5357            )));
5358        }
5359
5360        let inner = &type_str[7..type_str.len() - 1];
5361        if inner.is_empty() {
5362            return Err(Error::schema(format!("Empty frozen type: {}", type_str)));
5363        }
5364
5365        Ok(inner.to_string())
5366    }
5367
5368    /// Check if a type string represents a UDT (User-Defined Type).
5369    /// Detects Cassandra's internal format: org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.UserType(...)
5370    fn is_udt_type(type_str: &str) -> bool {
5371        // ASCII case-insensitive substring match without allocating a lowercased
5372        // copy. The marshal name is pure ASCII so byte-window comparison is safe.
5373        const TARGET: &[u8] = b"org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.usertype";
5374        let bytes = type_str.as_bytes();
5375        if bytes.len() < TARGET.len() {
5376            return false;
5377        }
5378        bytes
5379            .windows(TARGET.len())
5380            .any(|w| w.iter().zip(TARGET).all(|(a, b)| a.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b)))
5381    }
5382
5383    /// Parse a UDT type string to extract the UDT definition.
5384    /// Cassandra encodes UDTs as:
5385    /// `UserType(keyspace,hex_name,field1_hex:type1,field2_hex:type2,...)`
5386    ///
5387    /// Example:
5388    /// ```text
5389    /// org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.UserType(
5390    ///   test_collections,
5391    ///   616464726573735f74797065,    // hex("address_type")
5392    ///   737472656574:UTF8Type,        // street:UTF8Type
5393    ///   63697479:UTF8Type,            // city:UTF8Type
5394    ///   ...
5395    /// )
5396    /// ```
5397    fn parse_udt_type_definition(type_str: &str) -> Result<UdtTypeDef> {
5398        Self::parse_udt_type_definition_with_depth(type_str, 0)
5399    }
5400
5401    /// Internal implementation of parse_udt_type_definition with recursion depth tracking.
5402    fn parse_udt_type_definition_with_depth(type_str: &str, depth: usize) -> Result<UdtTypeDef> {
5403        // Check recursion depth to prevent stack overflow
5404        if depth > MAX_TYPE_NESTING_DEPTH {
5405            return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5406                "UDT nesting depth {} exceeds maximum {}. Type string: {}",
5407                depth,
5408                MAX_TYPE_NESTING_DEPTH,
5409                type_str.chars().take(100).collect::<String>()
5410            )));
5411        }
5412
5413        // Find the UserType(...) portion (case-insensitive search)
5414        let start_marker = "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.UserType(";
5415        let type_lower = type_str.to_lowercase();
5416        let start_marker_lower = start_marker.to_lowercase();
5417        let start_idx = type_lower
5418            .find(&start_marker_lower)
5419            .ok_or_else(|| Error::schema(format!("Not a UserType: {}", type_str)))?;
5420
5421        // Find the matching close paren (handling nested types)
5422        let inner_start = start_idx + start_marker.len();
5423        let mut paren_depth = 1;
5424        let mut end_idx = inner_start;
5425        let chars: Vec<char> = type_str[inner_start..].chars().collect();
5426
5427        for (i, c) in chars.iter().enumerate() {
5428            match c {
5429                '(' => paren_depth += 1,
5430                ')' => {
5431                    paren_depth -= 1;
5432                    if paren_depth == 0 {
5433                        end_idx = inner_start + i;
5434                        break;
5435                    }
5436                }
5437                _ => {}
5438            }
5439        }
5440
5441        if paren_depth != 0 {
5442            return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5443                "Unbalanced parentheses in UserType: {}",
5444                type_str
5445            )));
5446        }
5447
5448        let inner = &type_str[inner_start..end_idx];
5449
5450        // Split by comma, but respect nested parentheses
5451        let parts = Self::split_type_args(inner)?;
5452        if parts.len() < 2 {
5453            return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5454                "UserType requires at least keyspace and name: {}",
5455                inner
5456            )));
5457        }
5458
5459        // First part is keyspace
5460        let keyspace = parts[0].trim();
5461        if keyspace.is_empty() {
5462            return Err(Error::schema("UDT keyspace cannot be empty"));
5463        }
5464        let keyspace = keyspace.to_string();
5465
5466        // Second part is hex-encoded type name
5467        let udt_name = Self::decode_hex_name(parts[1].trim())?;
5468
5469        // Remaining parts are field definitions: hex_name:type
5470        let mut udt_def = UdtTypeDef::new(keyspace, udt_name);
5471        for field_def in parts.iter().skip(2) {
5472            let field_def = field_def.trim();
5473            if field_def.is_empty() {
5474                continue;
5475            }
5476
5477            // Split on first colon (field name is before, type is after)
5478            if let Some(colon_idx) = field_def.find(':') {
5479                let field_name_hex = &field_def[..colon_idx];
5480                let field_type_str = &field_def[colon_idx + 1..];
5481
5482                let field_name = Self::decode_hex_name(field_name_hex)?;
5483                // Use depth-aware version to track recursion through UDT fields
5484                let field_type = Self::parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(field_type_str, depth)?;
5485
5486                udt_def = udt_def.with_field(field_name, field_type, true);
5487            } else {
5488                return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5489                    "Invalid UDT field definition (missing colon): {}",
5490                    field_def
5491                )));
5492            }
5493        }
5494
5495        Ok(udt_def)
5496    }
5497
5498    /// Split type arguments by comma, respecting nested parentheses.
5499    fn split_type_args(s: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
5500        let mut parts = Vec::new();
5501        let mut current = String::new();
5502        let mut depth = 0;
5503
5504        for c in s.chars() {
5505            match c {
5506                '(' => {
5507                    depth += 1;
5508                    current.push(c);
5509                }
5510                ')' => {
5511                    depth -= 1;
5512                    current.push(c);
5513                }
5514                ',' if depth == 0 => {
5515                    parts.push(current.clone());
5516                    current.clear();
5517                }
5518                _ => current.push(c),
5519            }
5520        }
5521
5522        if !current.is_empty() {
5523            parts.push(current);
5524        }
5525
5526        Ok(parts)
5527    }
5528
5529    /// Decode a hex-encoded name (e.g., "616464726573735f74797065" -> "address_type")
5530    fn decode_hex_name(hex: &str) -> Result<String> {
5531        let bytes = hex::decode(hex)
5532            .map_err(|e| Error::schema(format!("Invalid hex-encoded UDT name '{}': {}", hex, e)))?;
5533        String::from_utf8(bytes)
5534            .map_err(|e| Error::schema(format!("Invalid UTF-8 in UDT name '{}': {}", hex, e)))
5535    }
5536
5537    /// Parse a Cassandra type string into a CqlType.
5538    /// Handles: UTF8Type, Int32Type, ListType(...), SetType(...), MapType(...), UserType(...), FrozenType(...)
5539    #[allow(dead_code)]
5540    fn parse_cassandra_type(type_str: &str) -> Result<CqlType> {
5541        Self::parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(type_str, 0)
5542    }
5543
5544    /// Internal implementation of parse_cassandra_type with recursion depth tracking.
5545    fn parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(type_str: &str, depth: usize) -> Result<CqlType> {
5546        // Check recursion depth to prevent stack overflow
5547        if depth > MAX_TYPE_NESTING_DEPTH {
5548            return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5549                "Type nesting depth {} exceeds maximum {}. Type string: {}",
5550                depth,
5551                MAX_TYPE_NESTING_DEPTH,
5552                type_str.chars().take(100).collect::<String>()
5553            )));
5554        }
5555
5556        let type_str = type_str.trim();
5557
5558        // Handle FrozenType wrapper
5559        if type_str.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.FrozenType(") {
5560            let inner_start = "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.FrozenType(".len();
5561            let inner = Self::extract_inner_parens(&type_str[inner_start..])?;
5562            let inner_type = Self::parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(&inner, depth + 1)?;
5563            return Ok(CqlType::Frozen(Box::new(inner_type)));
5564        }
5565
5566        // Handle UserType (nested UDT)
5567        if type_str.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.UserType(") {
5568            let udt_def = Self::parse_udt_type_definition_with_depth(type_str, depth + 1)?;
5569            let fields: Vec<(String, CqlType)> = udt_def
5570                .fields
5571                .into_iter()
5572                .map(|f| (f.name, f.field_type))
5573                .collect();
5574            return Ok(CqlType::Udt(udt_def.name, fields));
5575        }
5576
5577        // Handle collection types
5578        if type_str.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.ListType(") {
5579            let inner_start = "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.ListType(".len();
5580            let inner = Self::extract_inner_parens(&type_str[inner_start..])?;
5581            let elem_type = Self::parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(&inner, depth + 1)?;
5582            return Ok(CqlType::List(Box::new(elem_type)));
5583        }
5584
5585        if type_str.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.SetType(") {
5586            let inner_start = "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.SetType(".len();
5587            let inner = Self::extract_inner_parens(&type_str[inner_start..])?;
5588            let elem_type = Self::parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(&inner, depth + 1)?;
5589            return Ok(CqlType::Set(Box::new(elem_type)));
5590        }
5591
5592        if type_str.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.MapType(") {
5593            let inner_start = "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.MapType(".len();
5594            let inner = Self::extract_inner_parens(&type_str[inner_start..])?;
5595            let parts = Self::split_type_args(&inner)?;
5596            if parts.len() != 2 {
5597                return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5598                    "MapType requires exactly 2 type arguments: {}",
5599                    type_str
5600                )));
5601            }
5602            let key_type = Self::parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(&parts[0], depth + 1)?;
5603            let val_type = Self::parse_cassandra_type_with_depth(&parts[1], depth + 1)?;
5604            return Ok(CqlType::Map(Box::new(key_type), Box::new(val_type)));
5605        }
5606
5607        // Handle primitive types
5608        Ok(match type_str {
5609            s if s.ends_with("UTF8Type") => CqlType::Text,
5610            s if s.ends_with("AsciiType") => CqlType::Ascii,
5611            s if s.ends_with("Int32Type") => CqlType::Int,
5612            s if s.ends_with("LongType") => CqlType::BigInt,
5613            s if s.ends_with("FloatType") => CqlType::Float,
5614            s if s.ends_with("DoubleType") => CqlType::Double,
5615            s if s.ends_with("BooleanType") => CqlType::Boolean,
5616            s if s.ends_with("UUIDType") || s.ends_with("TimeUUIDType") => CqlType::Uuid,
5617            s if s.ends_with("TimestampType") => CqlType::Timestamp,
5618            s if s.ends_with("DateType") || s.ends_with("SimpleDateType") => CqlType::Date,
5619            s if s.ends_with("TimeType") => CqlType::Time,
5620            s if s.ends_with("DecimalType") => CqlType::Decimal,
5621            s if s.ends_with("IntegerType") => CqlType::Varint,
5622            s if s.ends_with("BytesType") => CqlType::Blob,
5623            s if s.ends_with("InetAddressType") => CqlType::Inet,
5624            _ => CqlType::Custom(type_str.to_string()),
5625        })
5626    }
5627
5628    /// Extract the contents inside parentheses, respecting nesting.
5629    fn extract_inner_parens(s: &str) -> Result<String> {
5630        let mut depth = 1;
5631        let mut end_idx = 0;
5632        let chars: Vec<char> = s.chars().collect();
5633
5634        for (i, c) in chars.iter().enumerate() {
5635            match c {
5636                '(' => depth += 1,
5637                ')' => {
5638                    depth -= 1;
5639                    if depth == 0 {
5640                        end_idx = i;
5641                        break;
5642                    }
5643                }
5644                _ => {}
5645            }
5646        }
5647
5648        if depth != 0 {
5649            return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5650                "Unbalanced parentheses in type: {}",
5651                s
5652            )));
5653        }
5654
5655        Ok(s[..end_idx].to_string())
5656    }
5657
5658    /// Parse a UDT value from binary data using the given UDT definition.
5659    /// UDT binary format (frozen):
5660    /// - For each field in schema order:
5661    ///   - [4 bytes BE i32]: field length (-1 = null, 0 = empty, >0 = data length)
5662    ///   - [N bytes]: field data (if length > 0)
5663    fn parse_udt_value(
5664        &self,
5665        data: &[u8],
5666        offset: usize,
5667        udt_def: &UdtTypeDef,
5668        _column: &crate::schema::Column,
5669        reader: &super::super::types::SSTableReader,
5670    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
5671        // Validate field count to prevent memory exhaustion
5672        if udt_def.fields.len() > MAX_UDT_FIELD_COUNT {
5673            return Err(Error::schema(format!(
5674                "UDT '{}' has {} fields, exceeds maximum {}",
5675                udt_def.name,
5676                udt_def.fields.len(),
5677                MAX_UDT_FIELD_COUNT
5678            )));
5679        }
5680
5681        let mut current_offset = offset;
5682        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(udt_def.fields.len());
5683
5684        log::debug!(
5685            "V5CompressedLegacy: Parsing UDT '{}' with {} fields at offset {}",
5686            udt_def.name,
5687            udt_def.fields.len(),
5688            offset
5689        );
5690
5691        for field_def in &udt_def.fields {
5692            // Check bounds for field length (4 bytes)
5693            if current_offset + 4 > data.len() {
5694                // Trailing fields can be omitted (implicit null)
5695                log::debug!(
5696                    "V5CompressedLegacy: UDT field '{}' omitted (implicit null), remaining fields omitted",
5697                    field_def.name
5698                );
5699                // Fill remaining fields with null
5700                while fields.len() < udt_def.fields.len() {
5701                    let remaining_field = &udt_def.fields[fields.len()];
5702                    fields.push(UdtField {
5703                        name: remaining_field.name.clone(),
5704                        value: None,
5705                    });
5706                }
5707                break;
5708            }
5709
5710            // Read field length (4 bytes big-endian i32)
5711            let field_len = i32::from_be_bytes([
5712                data[current_offset],
5713                data[current_offset + 1],
5714                data[current_offset + 2],
5715                data[current_offset + 3],
5716            ]);
5717            current_offset += 4;
5718
5719            let field_value = if field_len == -1 {
5720                // Null field
5721                log::debug!("V5CompressedLegacy: UDT field '{}' is null", field_def.name);
5722                None
5723            } else if field_len == 0 {
5724                // Empty field - create empty value based on type
5725                log::debug!(
5726                    "V5CompressedLegacy: UDT field '{}' is empty",
5727                    field_def.name
5728                );
5729                Some(Self::create_empty_value_for_type(&field_def.field_type))
5730            } else if field_len < 0 {
5731                // Validation: reject other negative values
5732                return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5733                    "UDT field '{}': invalid negative field length {}",
5734                    field_def.name, field_len
5735                )));
5736            } else {
5737                // Field with data
5738                let field_len = field_len as usize;
5739                if current_offset + field_len > data.len() {
5740                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5741                        "UDT field '{}': need {} bytes but only {} available at offset {}",
5742                        field_def.name,
5743                        field_len,
5744                        data.len() - current_offset,
5745                        current_offset
5746                    )));
5747                }
5748
5749                let field_data = &data[current_offset..current_offset + field_len];
5750                current_offset += field_len;
5751
5752                log::debug!(
5753                    "V5CompressedLegacy: UDT field '{}' has {} bytes of data",
5754                    field_def.name,
5755                    field_len
5756                );
5757
5758                // Parse field value based on its type
5759                let value =
5760                    self.parse_udt_field_value(field_data, &field_def.field_type, reader)?;
5761                Some(value)
5762            };
5763
5764            fields.push(UdtField {
5765                name: field_def.name.clone(),
5766                value: field_value,
5767            });
5768        }
5769
5770        let udt_value = UdtValue {
5771            type_name: udt_def.name.clone(),
5772            keyspace: udt_def.keyspace.clone(),
5773            fields,
5774        };
5775
5776        Ok((Value::Udt(udt_value), current_offset))
5777    }
5778
5779    /// Parse a UDT field value based on its CqlType.
5780    fn parse_udt_field_value(
5781        &self,
5782        data: &[u8],
5783        field_type: &CqlType,
5784        reader: &super::super::types::SSTableReader,
5785    ) -> Result<Value> {
5786        match field_type {
5787            CqlType::Text | CqlType::Ascii => {
5788                let s = String::from_utf8(data.to_vec())
5789                    .map_err(|e| Error::corruption(format!("Invalid UTF-8 in UDT field: {}", e)))?;
5790                Ok(Value::Text(s))
5791            }
5792            CqlType::Int => {
5793                if data.len() != 4 {
5794                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5795                        "Int field requires 4 bytes, got {}",
5796                        data.len()
5797                    )));
5798                }
5799                let v = i32::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
5800                Ok(Value::Integer(v))
5801            }
5802            CqlType::BigInt => {
5803                if data.len() != 8 {
5804                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5805                        "BigInt field requires 8 bytes, got {}",
5806                        data.len()
5807                    )));
5808                }
5809                let v = i64::from_be_bytes([
5810                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
5811                ]);
5812                Ok(Value::BigInt(v))
5813            }
5814            CqlType::Float => {
5815                if data.len() != 4 {
5816                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5817                        "Float field requires 4 bytes, got {}",
5818                        data.len()
5819                    )));
5820                }
5821                let bits = u32::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
5822                Ok(Value::Float32(f32::from_bits(bits)))
5823            }
5824            CqlType::Double => {
5825                if data.len() != 8 {
5826                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5827                        "Double field requires 8 bytes, got {}",
5828                        data.len()
5829                    )));
5830                }
5831                let bits = u64::from_be_bytes([
5832                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
5833                ]);
5834                Ok(Value::Float(f64::from_bits(bits)))
5835            }
5836            CqlType::Boolean => {
5837                if data.len() != 1 {
5838                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5839                        "Boolean field requires 1 byte, got {}",
5840                        data.len()
5841                    )));
5842                }
5843                Ok(Value::Boolean(data[0] != 0))
5844            }
5845            CqlType::Uuid => {
5846                if data.len() != 16 {
5847                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5848                        "UUID field requires 16 bytes, got {}",
5849                        data.len()
5850                    )));
5851                }
5852                let uuid_bytes: [u8; 16] = data[0..16]
5853                    .try_into()
5854                    .map_err(|_| Error::corruption("UUID byte conversion failed"))?;
5855                Ok(Value::Uuid(uuid_bytes))
5856            }
5857            CqlType::Timestamp => {
5858                if data.len() != 8 {
5859                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5860                        "Timestamp field requires 8 bytes, got {}",
5861                        data.len()
5862                    )));
5863                }
5864                let millis = i64::from_be_bytes([
5865                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
5866                ]);
5867                Ok(Value::Timestamp(millis))
5868            }
5869            CqlType::Date => {
5870                if data.len() != 4 {
5871                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5872                        "Date field requires 4 bytes, got {}",
5873                        data.len()
5874                    )));
5875                }
5876                let days = u32::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
5877                Ok(Value::Date(days as i32))
5878            }
5879            CqlType::Blob => Ok(Value::Blob(data.to_vec())),
5880            CqlType::Inet => Ok(Value::Inet(data.to_vec())),
5881            CqlType::Frozen(inner) => {
5882                // Parse the inner type and wrap in Frozen
5883                let inner_value = self.parse_udt_field_value(data, inner, reader)?;
5884                Ok(Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value)))
5885            }
5886            CqlType::Udt(name, field_defs) => {
5887                // Nested UDT - recursively parse
5888                let mut nested_def = UdtTypeDef::new("".to_string(), name.clone());
5889                for (field_name, field_type) in field_defs {
5890                    nested_def =
5891                        nested_def.with_field(field_name.clone(), field_type.clone(), true);
5892                }
5893                let dummy_column = crate::schema::Column {
5894                    name: name.clone(),
5895                    data_type: "udt".to_string(),
5896                    nullable: true,
5897                    default: None,
5898                    is_static: false,
5899                };
5900                let (value, _) =
5901                    self.parse_udt_value(data, 0, &nested_def, &dummy_column, reader)?;
5902                Ok(value)
5903            }
5904            _ => {
5905                // For other types, return as blob
5906                log::debug!(
5907                    "V5CompressedLegacy: UDT field type {:?} parsed as blob ({} bytes)",
5908                    field_type,
5909                    data.len()
5910                );
5911                Ok(Value::Blob(data.to_vec()))
5912            }
5913        }
5914    }
5915
5916    /// Create an empty value for a given CQL type.
5917    fn create_empty_value_for_type(cql_type: &CqlType) -> Value {
5918        match cql_type {
5919            CqlType::Text | CqlType::Ascii => Value::Text(String::new()),
5920            CqlType::Blob => Value::Blob(Vec::new()),
5921            CqlType::List(_) => Value::List(Vec::new()),
5922            CqlType::Set(_) => Value::Set(Vec::new()),
5923            CqlType::Map(_, _) => Value::Map(Vec::new()),
5924            _ => Value::Blob(Vec::new()),
5925        }
5926    }
5927
5928    /// Parse a CounterContext structure and return the total counter value.
5929    ///
5930    /// Counter cells in Cassandra store a CounterContext, not a raw i64 value.
5931    /// The CounterContext tracks counter updates across multiple replicas (shards).
5932    ///
5933    /// Format (from Cassandra's CounterContext.java):
5934    /// ```text
5935    /// [header_size: 2-byte BE signed short]    <- Number of shards (negative if cleanup needed)
5936    /// [indices: 2 bytes * |header_size|]       <- Shard type indicators (negative = global)
5937    /// [shards: 32 bytes each]:
5938    ///     [counter_id: 16 bytes UUID]          <- Replica's CounterId
5939    ///     [clock: 8-byte BE unsigned long]     <- Logical clock
5940    ///     [count: 8-byte BE signed long]       <- The actual counter value for this shard
5941    /// ```
5942    ///
5943    /// The counter value is the sum of all shard counts, matching Cassandra's `total()` function.
5944    ///
5945    /// Returns (total_value, bytes_consumed)
5946    fn parse_counter_context(
5947        data: &[u8],
5948        offset: usize,
5949        column_name: &str,
5950    ) -> Result<(i64, usize)> {
5951        // Constants from CounterContext.java
5952        const HEADER_SIZE_LENGTH: usize = 2;
5953        const HEADER_ELT_LENGTH: usize = 2;
5954        const COUNTER_ID_LENGTH: usize = 16;
5955        const CLOCK_LENGTH: usize = 8;
5956        const COUNT_LENGTH: usize = 8;
5957        const STEP_LENGTH: usize = COUNTER_ID_LENGTH + CLOCK_LENGTH + COUNT_LENGTH; // 32
5958
5959        // Maximum reasonable shard count to prevent DoS from corrupted data
5960        // A typical Cassandra cluster has at most 100-500 nodes, so 1024 is generous
5961        const MAX_COUNTER_SHARDS: usize = 1024;
5962
5963        let mut pos = offset;
5964
5965        // Read header_size (2-byte BE signed short)
5966        if pos + HEADER_SIZE_LENGTH > data.len() {
5967            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5968                "Counter '{}': need {} bytes for header_size at offset {}, only {} available",
5969                column_name,
5970                HEADER_SIZE_LENGTH,
5971                pos,
5972                data.len() - pos
5973            )));
5974        }
5975        let header_size_raw = i16::from_be_bytes([data[pos], data[pos + 1]]);
5976        // Negative header_size indicates local shards need cleanup (CASSANDRA-1938).
5977        // The absolute value gives the actual shard count.
5978        let shard_count = header_size_raw.unsigned_abs() as usize;
5979        pos += HEADER_SIZE_LENGTH;
5980
5981        // Validate shard count to prevent DoS from corrupted data
5982        if shard_count > MAX_COUNTER_SHARDS {
5983            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
5984                "Counter '{}': unreasonable shard count {} (max {})",
5985                column_name, shard_count, MAX_COUNTER_SHARDS
5986            )));
5987        }
5988
5989        log::debug!(
5990            "V5CompressedLegacy: Counter '{}' header_size={}, shard_count={}",
5991            column_name,
5992            header_size_raw,
5993            shard_count
5994        );
5995
5996        // Handle empty counter context (0 shards = counter value of 0)
5997        if shard_count == 0 {
5998            return Ok((0, HEADER_SIZE_LENGTH));
5999        }
6000
6001        // Skip header indices (2 bytes per shard)
6002        let indices_size = HEADER_ELT_LENGTH * shard_count;
6003        if pos + indices_size > data.len() {
6004            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6005                "Counter '{}': need {} bytes for indices at offset {}, only {} available",
6006                column_name,
6007                indices_size,
6008                pos,
6009                data.len() - pos
6010            )));
6011        }
6012        pos += indices_size;
6013
6014        // Calculate expected body size
6015        let body_size = STEP_LENGTH * shard_count;
6016        if pos + body_size > data.len() {
6017            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6018                "Counter '{}': need {} bytes for {} shards at offset {}, only {} available",
6019                column_name,
6020                body_size,
6021                shard_count,
6022                pos,
6023                data.len() - pos
6024            )));
6025        }
6026
6027        // Sum count values from all shards (matching Cassandra's total() function)
6028        let mut total: i64 = 0;
6029        for shard_idx in 0..shard_count {
6030            // Skip counter_id (16 bytes) and clock (8 bytes), read count (8 bytes)
6031            let count_offset = pos + (shard_idx * STEP_LENGTH) + COUNTER_ID_LENGTH + CLOCK_LENGTH;
6032            let count = i64::from_be_bytes([
6033                data[count_offset],
6034                data[count_offset + 1],
6035                data[count_offset + 2],
6036                data[count_offset + 3],
6037                data[count_offset + 4],
6038                data[count_offset + 5],
6039                data[count_offset + 6],
6040                data[count_offset + 7],
6041            ]);
6042            // Use checked_add to detect overflow (unlike Java which silently wraps)
6043            total = total.checked_add(count).ok_or_else(|| {
6044                Error::corruption(format!(
6045                    "Counter '{}': integer overflow when summing shard {} (total={}, count={})",
6046                    column_name, shard_idx, total, count
6047                ))
6048            })?;
6049
6050            log::trace!(
6051                "V5CompressedLegacy: Counter '{}' shard {} count={}",
6052                column_name,
6053                shard_idx,
6054                count
6055            );
6056        }
6057
6058        // Total bytes consumed
6059        let consumed = HEADER_SIZE_LENGTH + indices_size + body_size;
6060
6061        Ok((total, consumed))
6062    }
6063
6064    /// Parse a UDT field value without requiring SSTableReader.
6065    /// This is a simplified version of parse_udt_field_value for use in frozen collection contexts.
6066    ///
6067    /// Limitation: Complex nested types (nested UDTs, nested collections) are returned as blobs.
6068    /// For full UDT support with nested types, use parse_udt_field_value with a reader.
6069    fn parse_simple_udt_field_value(data: &[u8], field_type: &CqlType) -> Result<Value> {
6070        match field_type {
6071            CqlType::Text | CqlType::Ascii => {
6072                let s = String::from_utf8(data.to_vec())
6073                    .map_err(|e| Error::corruption(format!("Invalid UTF-8 in UDT field: {}", e)))?;
6074                Ok(Value::Text(s))
6075            }
6076            CqlType::Int => {
6077                if data.len() != 4 {
6078                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6079                        "Int field requires 4 bytes, got {}",
6080                        data.len()
6081                    )));
6082                }
6083                let v = i32::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
6084                Ok(Value::Integer(v))
6085            }
6086            CqlType::BigInt => {
6087                if data.len() != 8 {
6088                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6089                        "BigInt field requires 8 bytes, got {}",
6090                        data.len()
6091                    )));
6092                }
6093                let v = i64::from_be_bytes([
6094                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
6095                ]);
6096                Ok(Value::BigInt(v))
6097            }
6098            CqlType::Boolean => {
6099                if data.len() != 1 {
6100                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6101                        "Boolean field requires 1 byte, got {}",
6102                        data.len()
6103                    )));
6104                }
6105                Ok(Value::Boolean(data[0] != 0))
6106            }
6107            CqlType::Float => {
6108                if data.len() != 4 {
6109                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6110                        "Float field requires 4 bytes, got {}",
6111                        data.len()
6112                    )));
6113                }
6114                let bits = u32::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
6115                Ok(Value::Float32(f32::from_bits(bits)))
6116            }
6117            CqlType::Double => {
6118                if data.len() != 8 {
6119                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6120                        "Double field requires 8 bytes, got {}",
6121                        data.len()
6122                    )));
6123                }
6124                let bits = u64::from_be_bytes([
6125                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
6126                ]);
6127                Ok(Value::Float(f64::from_bits(bits)))
6128            }
6129            CqlType::Uuid | CqlType::TimeUuid => {
6130                if data.len() != 16 {
6131                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6132                        "UUID field requires 16 bytes, got {}",
6133                        data.len()
6134                    )));
6135                }
6136                let uuid_bytes: [u8; 16] = data[0..16]
6137                    .try_into()
6138                    .map_err(|_| Error::corruption("UUID byte conversion failed"))?;
6139                Ok(Value::Uuid(uuid_bytes))
6140            }
6141            CqlType::Timestamp => {
6142                if data.len() != 8 {
6143                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6144                        "Timestamp field requires 8 bytes, got {}",
6145                        data.len()
6146                    )));
6147                }
6148                let millis = i64::from_be_bytes([
6149                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
6150                ]);
6151                Ok(Value::Timestamp(millis))
6152            }
6153            CqlType::Blob => Ok(Value::Blob(data.to_vec())),
6154            _ => {
6155                // For complex types (nested UDTs, collections, etc.), return as blob
6156                // These require SSTableReader for full parsing
6157                log::debug!(
6158                    "UDT field type {:?} in frozen context parsed as blob ({} bytes)",
6159                    field_type,
6160                    data.len()
6161                );
6162                Ok(Value::Blob(data.to_vec()))
6163            }
6164        }
6165    }
6166
6167    /// Parse a nested UDT from registry definition (Issue #238)
6168    /// Used when parsing UDT fields that are themselves UDTs
6169    fn parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
6170        &self,
6171        data: &[u8],
6172        udt_def: &crate::types::UdtTypeDef,
6173        registry: &UdtRegistry,
6174    ) -> Result<Value> {
6175        let mut current_offset = 0;
6176        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(udt_def.fields.len());
6177
6178        for field_def in &udt_def.fields {
6179            // Check bounds for field length (4 bytes BE i32)
6180            if current_offset + 4 > data.len() {
6181                // Trailing fields are implicit null
6182                while fields.len() < udt_def.fields.len() {
6183                    let remaining_field = &udt_def.fields[fields.len()];
6184                    fields.push(UdtField {
6185                        name: remaining_field.name.clone(),
6186                        value: None,
6187                    });
6188                }
6189                break;
6190            }
6191
6192            // Read field length (4 bytes big-endian i32)
6193            let field_len = i32::from_be_bytes([
6194                data[current_offset],
6195                data[current_offset + 1],
6196                data[current_offset + 2],
6197                data[current_offset + 3],
6198            ]);
6199            current_offset += 4;
6200
6201            let field_value = if field_len == -1 {
6202                None
6203            } else if field_len == 0 {
6204                let value = Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(&[], &field_def.field_type)?;
6205                Some(value)
6206            } else {
6207                let field_len = field_len as usize;
6208                if current_offset + field_len > data.len() {
6209                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6210                        "Nested UDT field '{}' extends beyond data",
6211                        field_def.name
6212                    )));
6213                }
6214
6215                let field_data = &data[current_offset..current_offset + field_len];
6216                current_offset += field_len;
6217
6218                // Handle deeply nested UDTs (including FROZEN<udt> types)
6219                let value = match &field_def.field_type {
6220                    CqlType::Custom(nested_type_name) => {
6221                        // Issue #239: Handle "udt:" prefix from schema parsing
6222                        let lookup_name = nested_type_name
6223                            .strip_prefix("udt:")
6224                            .unwrap_or(nested_type_name);
6225                        if let Some(nested_udt) = registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, lookup_name) {
6226                            self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(field_data, nested_udt, registry)?
6227                        } else {
6228                            Value::Blob(field_data.to_vec())
6229                        }
6230                    }
6231                    CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields) => {
6232                        // Inline UDT type - prefer registry, fall back to inline fields (Issue #239)
6233                        if let Some(nested_udt) = registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, udt_name) {
6234                            self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(field_data, nested_udt, registry)?
6235                        } else if !inline_fields.is_empty() {
6236                            // Issue #239: Use inline field definitions for nested UDTs
6237                            self.parse_inline_udt_value(field_data, udt_name, inline_fields, 1)?
6238                        } else {
6239                            Value::Blob(field_data.to_vec())
6240                        }
6241                    }
6242                    CqlType::Frozen(inner) => {
6243                        // Handle FROZEN<udt_type> - the inner type may be a UDT
6244                        match inner.as_ref() {
6245                            CqlType::Custom(nested_type_name) => {
6246                                // Issue #239: Handle "udt:" prefix from schema parsing
6247                                let lookup_name = nested_type_name
6248                                    .strip_prefix("udt:")
6249                                    .unwrap_or(nested_type_name);
6250                                if let Some(nested_udt) =
6251                                    registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, lookup_name)
6252                                {
6253                                    let inner_value = self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
6254                                        field_data, nested_udt, registry,
6255                                    )?;
6256                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
6257                                } else {
6258                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(Value::Blob(field_data.to_vec())))
6259                                }
6260                            }
6261                            CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields) => {
6262                                // Prefer registry, fall back to inline fields (Issue #239)
6263                                if let Some(nested_udt) = registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, udt_name)
6264                                {
6265                                    let inner_value = self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
6266                                        field_data, nested_udt, registry,
6267                                    )?;
6268                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
6269                                } else if !inline_fields.is_empty() {
6270                                    // Issue #239: Use inline field definitions
6271                                    let inner_value = self.parse_inline_udt_value(
6272                                        field_data,
6273                                        udt_name,
6274                                        inline_fields,
6275                                        1,
6276                                    )?;
6277                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
6278                                } else {
6279                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(Value::Blob(field_data.to_vec())))
6280                                }
6281                            }
6282                            _ => {
6283                                // Other frozen types - parse as simple value
6284                                let inner_value =
6285                                    Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(field_data, inner)?;
6286                                Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
6287                            }
6288                        }
6289                    }
6290                    _ => Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(field_data, &field_def.field_type)?,
6291                };
6292                Some(value)
6293            };
6294
6295            fields.push(UdtField {
6296                name: field_def.name.clone(),
6297                value: field_value,
6298            });
6299        }
6300
6301        Ok(Value::Udt(UdtValue {
6302            type_name: udt_def.name.clone(),
6303            keyspace: udt_def.keyspace.clone(),
6304            fields,
6305        }))
6306    }
6307
6308    /// Parse a UDT using inline field definitions from CqlType::Udt
6309    /// Used when we have inline type info but no registry entry (Issue #239)
6310    ///
6311    /// This handles the case where a UDT contains a nested UDT field, and the
6312    /// nested UDT's field definitions are available inline in the CqlType structure
6313    /// (parsed from the Statistics.db type string) rather than from the UdtRegistry.
6314    fn parse_inline_udt_value(
6315        &self,
6316        data: &[u8],
6317        type_name: &str,
6318        inline_fields: &[(String, CqlType)],
6319        depth: usize,
6320    ) -> Result<Value> {
6321        if depth > MAX_TYPE_NESTING_DEPTH {
6322            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6323                "UDT nesting depth {} exceeds maximum {}",
6324                depth, MAX_TYPE_NESTING_DEPTH
6325            )));
6326        }
6327
6328        let mut current_offset = 0;
6329        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(inline_fields.len());
6330
6331        for (field_name, field_type) in inline_fields {
6332            // Check bounds for field length (4 bytes BE i32)
6333            if current_offset + 4 > data.len() {
6334                // Trailing fields are implicit null
6335                while fields.len() < inline_fields.len() {
6336                    let remaining_field = &inline_fields[fields.len()];
6337                    fields.push(UdtField {
6338                        name: remaining_field.0.clone(),
6339                        value: None,
6340                    });
6341                }
6342                break;
6343            }
6344
6345            // Read field length (4 bytes big-endian i32)
6346            let field_len = i32::from_be_bytes([
6347                data[current_offset],
6348                data[current_offset + 1],
6349                data[current_offset + 2],
6350                data[current_offset + 3],
6351            ]);
6352            current_offset += 4;
6353
6354            let field_value = if field_len == -1 {
6355                // Null field
6356                None
6357            } else if field_len == 0 {
6358                // Empty value
6359                let value = Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(&[], field_type)?;
6360                Some(value)
6361            } else {
6362                let field_len = field_len as usize;
6363                if current_offset + field_len > data.len() {
6364                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
6365                        "Inline UDT field '{}' extends beyond data",
6366                        field_name
6367                    )));
6368                }
6369
6370                let field_data = &data[current_offset..current_offset + field_len];
6371                current_offset += field_len;
6372
6373                // Handle nested UDTs using inline field definitions (Issue #239)
6374                let value = match field_type {
6375                    CqlType::Udt(nested_name, nested_fields) if !nested_fields.is_empty() => {
6376                        // Recursively parse nested UDT using its inline fields
6377                        self.parse_inline_udt_value(
6378                            field_data,
6379                            nested_name,
6380                            nested_fields,
6381                            depth + 1,
6382                        )?
6383                    }
6384                    CqlType::Frozen(inner) => match inner.as_ref() {
6385                        CqlType::Udt(nested_name, nested_fields) if !nested_fields.is_empty() => {
6386                            // Frozen nested UDT - unwrap and parse
6387                            let inner_value = self.parse_inline_udt_value(
6388                                field_data,
6389                                nested_name,
6390                                nested_fields,
6391                                depth + 1,
6392                            )?;
6393                            Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
6394                        }
6395                        _ => {
6396                            // Other frozen types - parse as simple value
6397                            let inner_value =
6398                                Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(field_data, inner)?;
6399                            Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
6400                        }
6401                    },
6402                    _ => Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(field_data, field_type)?,
6403                };
6404                Some(value)
6405            };
6406
6407            fields.push(UdtField {
6408                name: field_name.clone(),
6409                value: field_value,
6410            });
6411        }
6412
6413        Ok(Value::Udt(UdtValue {
6414            type_name: type_name.to_string(),
6415            keyspace: self.keyspace.clone(),
6416            fields,
6417        }))
6418    }
6419
6420    /// Returns true if the column type is a complex column (non-frozen collection).
6421    /// Complex columns are stored as multiple cells with cell paths, unlike
6422    /// frozen collections which are stored as a single cell with blob value.
6423    ///
6424    /// Issue #221: This is critical for proper parsing - complex columns have
6425    /// a different format: [complex_deletion_time?] [cell_count] [cells...]
6426    fn is_complex_column(data_type: &str) -> bool {
6427        let dt = data_type.to_lowercase();
6428        // Non-frozen collections start directly with list/set/map (CQL syntax)
6429        // or org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.ListType/SetType/MapType (internal syntax)
6430        // Collections containing frozen element types (e.g., list<frozen<...>>) are still complex
6431        // collections because the outer collection is not frozen - only the elements are.
6432        // Only frozen<list<...>> etc. are not complex (they're single-cell frozen types)
6433
6434        // Check for frozen collections (which are NOT complex)
6435        if dt.starts_with("frozen<")
6436            || dt.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.frozentype(")
6437        {
6438            return false;
6439        }
6440
6441        // Check for CQL-style collection types
6442        if dt.starts_with("list<") || dt.starts_with("set<") || dt.starts_with("map<") {
6443            return true;
6444        }
6445
6446        // Check for Cassandra internal collection types
6447        if dt.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.listtype(")
6448            || dt.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.settype(")
6449            || dt.starts_with("org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.maptype(")
6450        {
6451            return true;
6452        }
6453
6454        // Issue #927: a TOP-LEVEL non-frozen UDT is a first-class multi-cell
6455        // complex column — each field is stored as its own cell whose cell_path
6456        // is the 2-byte (signed ShortType) field index. Frozen UDTs were already
