8129                // Timestamp: 8 bytes (milliseconds since epoch)
8130                if offset + 8 > data.len() {
8131                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8132                        "Frozen element '{}': need 8 bytes for timestamp, only {} available",
8133                        column_name,
8134                        data.len() - offset
8135                    )));
8136                }
8137                let ts = i64::from_be_bytes([
8138                    data[offset],
8139                    data[offset + 1],
8140                    data[offset + 2],
8141                    data[offset + 3],
8142                    data[offset + 4],
8143                    data[offset + 5],
8144                    data[offset + 6],
8145                    data[offset + 7],
8146                ]);
8147                offset += 8;
8148                Value::Timestamp(ts)
8149            }
8150
8151            "date" => {
8152                // Date: [VInt len=4][u32 BE days since epoch]
8153                let (remaining, date_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
8154                    Error::corruption(format!(
8155                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse date length as VInt: {:?}",
8156                        column_name, e
8157                    ))
8158                })?;
8159                let date_len = date_len as usize;
8160                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
8161                offset += bytes_consumed;
8162
8163                if date_len != 4 {
8164                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8165                        "Frozen element '{}': expected date length 4, got {}",
8166                        column_name, date_len
8167                    )));
8168                }
8169
8170                if offset + 4 > data.len() {
8171                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8172                        "Frozen element '{}': need 4 bytes for date, only {} available",
8173                        column_name,
8174                        data.len() - offset
8175                    )));
8176                }
8177
8178                let stored = u32::from_be_bytes([
8179                    data[offset],
8180                    data[offset + 1],
8181                    data[offset + 2],
8182                    data[offset + 3],
8183                ]);
8184                offset += 4;
8185                // Cassandra DATE: 4-byte unsigned int with Integer.MIN_VALUE offset
8186                let days_since_epoch = stored.wrapping_add(i32::MIN as u32) as i32;
8187                Value::Date(days_since_epoch)
8188            }
8189
8190            "time" => {
8191                // Time: [VInt len=8][i64 BE nanoseconds since midnight]
8192                let (remaining, time_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
8193                    Error::corruption(format!(
8194                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse time length as VInt: {:?}",
8195                        column_name, e
8196                    ))
8197                })?;
8198                let time_len = time_len as usize;
8199                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
8200                offset += bytes_consumed;
8201
8202                if time_len != 8 {
8203                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8204                        "Frozen element '{}': expected time length 8, got {}",
8205                        column_name, time_len
8206                    )));
8207                }
8208
8209                if offset + 8 > data.len() {
8210                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8211                        "Frozen element '{}': need 8 bytes for time, only {} available",
8212                        column_name,
8213                        data.len() - offset
8214                    )));
8215                }
8216
8217                let nanos = i64::from_be_bytes([
8218                    data[offset],
8219                    data[offset + 1],
8220                    data[offset + 2],
8221                    data[offset + 3],
8222                    data[offset + 4],
8223                    data[offset + 5],
8224                    data[offset + 6],
8225                    data[offset + 7],
8226                ]);
8227                offset += 8;
8228                Value::Time(nanos)
8229            }
8230
8231            "duration" => {
8232                // Duration: [VInt len][months VInt][days VInt][nanos VInt]
8233                let (remaining, duration_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
8234                    Error::corruption(format!(
8235                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse duration length as VInt: {:?}",
8236                        column_name, e
8237                    ))
8238                })?;
8239                let duration_len = duration_len as usize;
8240                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
8241                offset += bytes_consumed;
8242
8243                if offset + duration_len > data.len() {
8244                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8245                        "Frozen element '{}': need {} bytes for duration, only {} available",
8246                        column_name,
8247                        duration_len,
8248                        data.len() - offset
8249                    )));
8250                }
8251
8252                // Parse three VInt components from the duration_len bytes
8253                let duration_bytes = &data[offset..offset + duration_len];
8254
8255                // Parse months (signed VInt)
8256                let (remaining, months) = parse_vint(duration_bytes).map_err(|e| {
8257                    Error::corruption(format!(
8258                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse duration months: {:?}",
8259                        column_name, e
8260                    ))
8261                })?;
8262                let pos = duration_bytes.len() - remaining.len();
8263
8264                // Parse days (signed VInt)
8265                let (remaining, days) = parse_vint(&duration_bytes[pos..]).map_err(|e| {
8266                    Error::corruption(format!(
8267                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse duration days: {:?}",
8268                        column_name, e
8269                    ))
8270                })?;
8271                let pos = duration_bytes.len() - remaining.len();
8272
8273                // Parse nanoseconds (signed VInt)
8274                let (_remaining, nanos) = parse_vint(&duration_bytes[pos..]).map_err(|e| {
8275                    Error::corruption(format!(
8276                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse duration nanos: {:?}",
8277                        column_name, e
8278                    ))
8279                })?;
8280
8281                offset += duration_len;
8282                Value::Duration {
8283                    months: months as i32,
8284                    days: days as i32,
8285                    nanos,
8286                }
8287            }
8288
8289            "inet" => {
8290                // Inet: [VInt len][address bytes] (len is 4 for IPv4, 16 for IPv6)
8291                let (remaining, len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
8292                    Error::corruption(format!(
8293                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse inet length as VInt: {:?}",
8294                        column_name, e
8295                    ))
8296                })?;
8297                let len = len as usize;
8298                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
8299                offset += bytes_consumed;
8300
8301                if len != 4 && len != 16 {
8302                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8303                        "Frozen element '{}': invalid inet length {}, expected 4 or 16",
8304                        column_name, len
8305                    )));
8306                }
8307
8308                if offset + len > data.len() {
8309                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8310                        "Frozen element '{}': need {} bytes for inet, only {} available",
8311                        column_name,
8312                        len,
8313                        data.len() - offset
8314                    )));
8315                }
8316
8317                let bytes = data[offset..offset + len].to_vec();
8318                offset += len;
8319                Value::Inet(bytes)
8320            }
8321
8322            "blob" | "bytes" => {
8323                // Blob: [VInt len][bytes]
8324                let (remaining, blob_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
8325                    Error::corruption(format!(
8326                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse blob length as VInt: {:?}",
8327                        column_name, e
8328                    ))
8329                })?;
8330                let blob_len = blob_len as usize;
8331                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
8332                offset += bytes_consumed;
8333
8334                if offset + blob_len > data.len() {
8335                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8336                        "Frozen element '{}': need {} bytes for blob, only {} available",
8337                        column_name,
8338                        blob_len,
8339                        data.len() - offset
8340                    )));
8341                }
8342
8343                let blob_bytes = data[offset..offset + blob_len].to_vec();
8344                offset += blob_len;
8345                Value::Blob(blob_bytes)
8346            }
8347
8348            "smallint" | "short" => {
8349                // SmallInt: 2 bytes
8350                if offset + 2 > data.len() {
8351                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8352                        "Frozen element '{}': need 2 bytes for smallint, only {} available",
8353                        column_name,
8354                        data.len() - offset
8355                    )));
8356                }
8357                let val = i16::from_be_bytes([data[offset], data[offset + 1]]);
8358                offset += 2;
8359                Value::SmallInt(val)
8360            }
8361
8362            "tinyint" | "byte" => {
8363                // TinyInt: 1 byte
8364                if offset >= data.len() {
8365                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8366                        "Frozen element '{}': need 1 byte for tinyint, only {} available",
8367                        column_name,
8368                        data.len() - offset
8369                    )));
8370                }
8371                let val = data[offset] as i8;
8372                offset += 1;
8373                Value::TinyInt(val)
8374            }
8375
8376            "varint" => {
8377                // VarInt: [VInt len][bytes]
8378                let (remaining, varint_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
8379                    Error::corruption(format!(
8380                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse varint length as VInt: {:?}",
8381                        column_name, e
8382                    ))
8383                })?;
8384                let varint_len = varint_len as usize;
8385                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
8386                offset += bytes_consumed;
8387
8388                if offset + varint_len > data.len() {
8389                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8390                        "Frozen element '{}': need {} bytes for varint, only {} available",
8391                        column_name,
8392                        varint_len,
8393                        data.len() - offset
8394                    )));
8395                }
8396
8397                let varint_bytes = data[offset..offset + varint_len].to_vec();
8398                offset += varint_len;
8399                Value::Varint(varint_bytes)
8400            }
8401
8402            "decimal" => {
8403                // Decimal: [VInt total_len][i32 scale][unscaled bytes]
8404                let (remaining, total_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
8405                    Error::corruption(format!(
8406                        "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse decimal length as VInt: {:?}",
8407                        column_name, e
8408                    ))
8409                })?;
8410                let total_len = total_len as usize;
8411                let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
8412                offset += bytes_consumed;
8413
8414                if offset + total_len > data.len() {
8415                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8416                        "Frozen element '{}': need {} bytes for decimal, only {} available",
8417                        column_name,
8418                        total_len,
8419                        data.len() - offset
8420                    )));
8421                }
8422
8423                if total_len < 4 {
8424                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8425                        "Frozen element '{}': decimal length {} too small for scale",
8426                        column_name, total_len
8427                    )));
8428                }
8429
8430                let scale = i32::from_be_bytes([
8431                    data[offset],
8432                    data[offset + 1],
8433                    data[offset + 2],
8434                    data[offset + 3],
8435                ]);
8436                let unscaled = data[offset + 4..offset + total_len].to_vec();
8437                offset += total_len;
8438
8439                Value::Decimal { scale, unscaled }
8440            }
8441
8442            // Handle nested tuple types inside a frozen context.
8443            // In parse_raw_type_value the data slice is the full (unbounded) row buffer, so
8444            // `offset` marks where the tuple blob starts.  The tuple's per-element length
8445            // uses the [i32 BE len][bytes] wire format; the count comes from the type string.
8446            // There is NO outer VUInt blob-length prefix here because parse_raw_type_value is
8447            // called element-by-element from the frozen-collection parsers which have already
8448            // consumed the VUInt length for each element (via read_frozen_element).
8449            //
8450            // Safety invariant: every caller of parse_raw_type_value for a tuple element
8451            // pre-slices `data` to the exact element bytes (via read_frozen_element or
8452            // parse_frozen_sequence_value_raw), so `data.len()` is the true tuple extent.
8453            // parse_tuple_elements_raw iterates only over schema-derived element_types, so it
8454            // stops at the schema arity regardless of wire arity, and the returned `offset`
8455            // is the position after the last schema-specified element's bytes — which is
8456            // correct because the caller already holds the bounded slice.
8457            type_str if type_str.starts_with("tuple<") => {
8458                let element_types = self.extract_tuple_element_types(type_str)?;
8459                if element_types.is_empty() {
8460                    return Err(Error::schema(format!(
8461                        "Frozen element '{}': empty tuple type",
8462                        column_name
8463                    )));
8464                }
8465                // blob_end = data.len() is correct: callers pre-slice data to the tuple extent.
8466                let blob_end = data.len();
8467                let mut off = offset;
8468                let elements = self.parse_tuple_elements_raw(
8469                    data,
8470                    &mut off,
8471                    blob_end,
8472                    &element_types,
8473                    column_name,
8474                    depth + 1,
8475                )?;
8476                offset = off;
8477                Value::Tuple(elements)
8478            }
8479
8480            // Handle nested frozen types
8481            type_str if type_str.starts_with("frozen<") => {
8482                let inner_type = self.extract_frozen_inner_type(type_str)?;
8483                let (inner_value, new_offset) =
8484                    self.parse_raw_type_value(data, offset, &inner_type, column_name, depth + 1)?;
8485                offset = new_offset;
8486                Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8487            }
8488
8489            // Handle nested collections inside frozen context
8490            type_str if type_str.starts_with("list<") => {
8491                let element_type = self.extract_collection_element_type(type_str, "list")?;
8492                let (list_value, new_offset) = self.parse_frozen_list_value_raw(
8493                    data,
8494                    offset,
8495                    &element_type,
8496                    column_name,
8497                    depth + 1,
8498                )?;
8499                offset = new_offset;
8500                list_value
8501            }
8502
8503            type_str if type_str.starts_with("set<") => {
8504                let element_type = self.extract_collection_element_type(type_str, "set")?;
8505                let (set_value, new_offset) = self.parse_frozen_set_value_raw(
8506                    data,
8507                    offset,
8508                    &element_type,
8509                    column_name,
8510                    depth + 1,
8511                )?;
8512                offset = new_offset;
8513                set_value
8514            }
8515
8516            type_str if type_str.starts_with("map<") => {
8517                let (key_type, value_type) = self.extract_map_types(type_str)?;
8518                let (map_value, new_offset) = self.parse_frozen_map_value_raw(
8519                    data,
8520                    offset,
8521                    &key_type,
8522                    &value_type,
8523                    column_name,
8524                    depth + 1,
8525                )?;
8526                offset = new_offset;
8527                map_value
8528            }
8529
8530            // Handle UDT (User-Defined Type) inside frozen collections
8531            // Note: We match against normalized (lowercased) but need original case for parsing
8532            normalized if Self::is_udt_type(normalized) => {
8533                log::debug!(
8534                    "Frozen element '{}': parsing UDT type '{}'",
8535                    column_name,
8536                    type_str
8537                );
8538
8539                // Parse UDT definition from the ORIGINAL type string (not lowercased)
8540                // because UserType parsing expects exact case "UserType"
8541                let udt_def = Self::parse_udt_type_definition(type_str)?;
8542
8543                // UDT data: The VInt length prefix has already been consumed by the caller
8544                // (either complex cell parser or frozen collection element parser).
8545                // The data slice passed to parse_raw_type_value is already the raw UDT bytes.
8546                let udt_data = &data[offset..];
8547
8548                if log::log_enabled!(log::Level::Debug) {
8549                    let hex: String = udt_data
8550                        .iter()
8551                        .take(64)
8552                        .map(|b| format!("{:02x}", b))
8553                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
8554                        .join(" ");
8555                    log::debug!(
8556                        "Frozen UDT '{}': data_len={}, hex dump: {}",
8557                        column_name,
8558                        udt_data.len(),
8559                        hex
8560                    );
8561                }
8562
8563                // TODO(Issue #220): Full UDT parsing requires SSTableReader for nested types.
8564                // parse_raw_type_value is called in frozen collection contexts where we don't
8565                // have access to reader. For now, parse simple fields and return blob for
8566                // complex nested types.
8567                //
8568                // Temporary solution: Parse UDT with limited nested type support
8569
8570                // Validate field count to prevent memory exhaustion
8571                if udt_def.fields.len() > MAX_UDT_FIELD_COUNT {
8572                    return Err(Error::schema(format!(
8573                        "UDT '{}' has {} fields, exceeds maximum {}",
8574                        udt_def.name,
8575                        udt_def.fields.len(),
8576                        MAX_UDT_FIELD_COUNT
8577                    )));
8578                }
8579
8580                let mut current_offset = 0;
8581                let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(udt_def.fields.len());
8582
8583                for field_def in &udt_def.fields {
8584                    // Check bounds for field length (4 bytes BE i32)
8585                    if current_offset + 4 > udt_data.len() {
8586                        // Trailing fields can be omitted (implicit null)
8587                        log::debug!(
8588                            "Frozen UDT field '{}' omitted (implicit null)",
8589                            field_def.name
8590                        );
8591                        while fields.len() < udt_def.fields.len() {
8592                            let remaining_field = &udt_def.fields[fields.len()];
8593                            fields.push(UdtField {
8594                                name: remaining_field.name.clone(),
8595                                value: None,
8596                            });
8597                        }
8598                        break;
8599                    }
8600
8601                    // Read field length (4 bytes big-endian i32)
8602                    let field_len = i32::from_be_bytes([
8603                        udt_data[current_offset],
8604                        udt_data[current_offset + 1],
8605                        udt_data[current_offset + 2],
8606                        udt_data[current_offset + 3],
8607                    ]);
8608                    log::debug!(
8609                        "Frozen UDT field '{}' at offset {}: length bytes={:02x} {:02x} {:02x} {:02x}, parsed length={}",
8610                        field_def.name,
8611                        current_offset,
8612                        udt_data[current_offset],
8613                        udt_data[current_offset + 1],
8614                        udt_data[current_offset + 2],
8615                        udt_data[current_offset + 3],
8616                        field_len
8617                    );
8618                    current_offset += 4;
8619
8620                    let field_value = if field_len == -1 {
8621                        // Null field
8622                        log::debug!("Frozen UDT field '{}' is null", field_def.name);
8623                        None
8624                    } else if field_len == 0 {
8625                        // Empty field
8626                        log::debug!("Frozen UDT field '{}' is empty", field_def.name);
8627                        Some(Self::create_empty_value_for_type(&field_def.field_type))
8628                    } else if field_len < 0 {
8629                        // Validation: reject other negative values
8630                        return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8631                            "Frozen UDT field '{}': invalid negative field length {}",
8632                            field_def.name, field_len
8633                        )));
8634                    } else {
8635                        // Field with data
8636                        let field_len = field_len as usize;
8637                        if current_offset + field_len > udt_data.len() {
8638                            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8639                                "Frozen UDT field '{}': need {} bytes but only {} available",
8640                                field_def.name,
8641                                field_len,
8642                                udt_data.len() - current_offset
8643                            )));
8644                        }
8645
8646                        let field_data = &udt_data[current_offset..current_offset + field_len];
8647                        current_offset += field_len;
8648
8649                        log::debug!(
8650                            "Frozen UDT field '{}' has {} bytes of data, type: {:?}",
8651                            field_def.name,
8652                            field_len,
8653                            field_def.field_type
8654                        );
8655
8656                        // Parse field value - handle nested UDTs specially (Issue #238)
8657                        let value = if let Some(ref registry) = self.udt_registry {
8658                            match &field_def.field_type {
8659                                CqlType::Custom(nested_type_name) => {
8660                                    // Issue #239: Handle "udt:" prefix from schema parsing
8661                                    let lookup_name = nested_type_name
8662                                        .strip_prefix("udt:")
8663                                        .unwrap_or(nested_type_name);
8664                                    if let Some(nested_udt) =
8665                                        registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, lookup_name)
8666                                    {
8667                                        self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8668                                            field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8669                                        )?
8670                                    } else {
8671                                        Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8672                                            field_data,
8673                                            &field_def.field_type,
8674                                        )?
8675                                    }
8676                                }
8677                                CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields) => {
8678                                    // Prefer registry, fall back to inline fields (Issue #239)
8679                                    if let Some(nested_udt) =
8680                                        registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, udt_name)
8681                                    {
8682                                        self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8683                                            field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8684                                        )?
8685                                    } else if !inline_fields.is_empty() {
8686                                        self.parse_inline_udt_value(
8687                                            field_data,
8688                                            udt_name,
8689                                            inline_fields,
8690                                            1,
8691                                        )?
8692                                    } else {
8693                                        Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8694                                            field_data,
8695                                            &field_def.field_type,
8696                                        )?
8697                                    }
8698                                }
8699                                CqlType::Frozen(inner) => match inner.as_ref() {
8700                                    CqlType::Custom(nested_type_name) => {
8701                                        // Issue #239: Handle "udt:" prefix from schema parsing
8702                                        let lookup_name = nested_type_name
8703                                            .strip_prefix("udt:")
8704                                            .unwrap_or(nested_type_name);
8705                                        if let Some(nested_udt) =
8706                                            registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, lookup_name)
8707                                        {
8708                                            let inner_value = self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8709                                                field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8710                                            )?;
8711                                            Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8712                                        } else {
8713                                            Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8714                                                field_data,
8715                                                &field_def.field_type,
8716                                            )?
8717                                        }
8718                                    }
8719                                    CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields) => {
8720                                        // Prefer registry, fall back to inline fields (Issue #239)
8721                                        if let Some(nested_udt) =
8722                                            registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, udt_name)
8723                                        {
8724                                            let inner_value = self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8725                                                field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8726                                            )?;
8727                                            Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8728                                        } else if !inline_fields.is_empty() {
8729                                            let inner_value = self.parse_inline_udt_value(
8730                                                field_data,
8731                                                udt_name,
8732                                                inline_fields,
8733                                                1,
8734                                            )?;
8735                                            Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8736                                        } else {
8737                                            Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8738                                                field_data,
8739                                                &field_def.field_type,
8740                                            )?
8741                                        }
8742                                    }
8743                                    _ => Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8744                                        field_data,
8745                                        &field_def.field_type,
8746                                    )?,
8747                                },
8748                                _ => Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8749                                    field_data,
8750                                    &field_def.field_type,
8751                                )?,
8752                            }
8753                        } else {
8754                            // No registry - check for inline UDT definitions (Issue #239)
8755                            match &field_def.field_type {
8756                                CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields)
8757                                    if !inline_fields.is_empty() =>
8758                                {
8759                                    self.parse_inline_udt_value(
8760                                        field_data,
8761                                        udt_name,
8762                                        inline_fields,
8763                                        1,
8764                                    )?
8765                                }
8766                                CqlType::Frozen(inner) => match inner.as_ref() {
8767                                    CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields)
8768                                        if !inline_fields.is_empty() =>
8769                                    {
8770                                        let inner_value = self.parse_inline_udt_value(
8771                                            field_data,
8772                                            udt_name,
8773                                            inline_fields,
8774                                            1,
8775                                        )?;
8776                                        Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8777                                    }
8778                                    _ => Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8779                                        field_data,
8780                                        &field_def.field_type,
8781                                    )?,
8782                                },
8783                                _ => Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8784                                    field_data,
8785                                    &field_def.field_type,
8786                                )?,
8787                            }
8788                        };
8789                        Some(value)
8790                    };
8791
8792                    fields.push(UdtField {
8793                        name: field_def.name.clone(),
8794                        value: field_value,
8795                    });
8796                }
8797
8798                let udt_value = UdtValue {
8799                    type_name: udt_def.name.clone(),
8800                    keyspace: udt_def.keyspace.clone(),
8801                    fields,
8802                };
8803
8804                // Update offset to point after the UDT data we consumed
8805                offset += current_offset;
8806
8807                Value::Udt(udt_value)
8808            }
8809
8810            // Default: check if it's a short UDT name in the registry, otherwise treat as blob
8811            _ => {
8812                // Try to look up as UDT in registry by short name (Issue #238)
8813                // This handles cases like "address_type" which aren't in full marshal format
8814                if let Some(ref registry) = self.udt_registry {
8815                    if let Some(udt_def) = registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, type_str) {
8816                        log::debug!(
8817                            "Frozen element '{}': found UDT '{}' in registry, parsing {} fields",
8818                            column_name,
8819                            type_str,
8820                            udt_def.fields.len()
8821                        );
8822
8823                        // Parse UDT fields using the registry definition
8824                        // UDT data in frozen context has 4-byte big-endian i32 length prefixes for each field
8825                        // (-1 means null, 0 means empty, positive means field data length)
8826                        let udt_data = &data[offset..];
8827                        let mut current_offset = 0;
8828                        let mut fields = Vec::with_capacity(udt_def.fields.len());
8829
8830                        for field_def in &udt_def.fields {
8831                            // Check bounds for field length (4 bytes BE i32)
8832                            if current_offset + 4 > udt_data.len() {
8833                                // Trailing fields can be omitted (implicit null)
8834                                log::debug!(
8835                                    "Frozen UDT field '{}' omitted (implicit null)",
8836                                    field_def.name
8837                                );
8838                                while fields.len() < udt_def.fields.len() {
8839                                    let remaining_field = &udt_def.fields[fields.len()];
8840                                    fields.push(UdtField {
8841                                        name: remaining_field.name.clone(),
8842                                        value: None,
8843                                    });
8844                                }
8845                                break;
8846                            }
8847
8848                            // Read field length (4 bytes big-endian i32)
8849                            let field_len = i32::from_be_bytes([
8850                                udt_data[current_offset],
8851                                udt_data[current_offset + 1],
8852                                udt_data[current_offset + 2],
8853                                udt_data[current_offset + 3],
8854                            ]);
8855                            current_offset += 4;
8856
8857                            let field_value = if field_len == -1 {
8858                                // Null field
8859                                None
8860                            } else if field_len == 0 {
8861                                // Empty field - parse with empty data
8862                                let value =
8863                                    Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(&[], &field_def.field_type)?;
8864                                Some(value)
8865                            } else {
8866                                let field_len = field_len as usize;
8867                                if current_offset + field_len > udt_data.len() {
8868                                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
8869                                        "Frozen UDT field '{}' extends beyond data (need {}, have {})",
8870                                        field_def.name,
8871                                        field_len,
8872                                        udt_data.len() - current_offset
8873                                    )));
8874                                }
8875
8876                                let field_data =
8877                                    &udt_data[current_offset..current_offset + field_len];
8878                                current_offset += field_len;
8879
8880                                // Parse field value - handle nested UDTs specially (including FROZEN<udt>)
8881                                let value = match &field_def.field_type {
8882                                    CqlType::Custom(nested_type_name) => {
8883                                        // Issue #239: Handle "udt:" prefix from schema parsing
8884                                        let lookup_name = nested_type_name
8885                                            .strip_prefix("udt:")
8886                                            .unwrap_or(nested_type_name);
8887                                        // Check if this is a nested UDT
8888                                        if let Some(nested_udt) =
8889                                            registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, lookup_name)
8890                                        {
8891                                            // Recursively parse nested UDT
8892                                            self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8893                                                field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8894                                            )?
8895                                        } else {
8896                                            // Unknown custom type - parse as blob
8897                                            Value::Blob(field_data.to_vec())
8898                                        }
8899                                    }
8900                                    CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields) => {
8901                                        // Prefer registry, fall back to inline fields (Issue #239)
8902                                        if let Some(nested_udt) =
8903                                            registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, udt_name)
8904                                        {
8905                                            self.parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8906                                                field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8907                                            )?
8908                                        } else if !inline_fields.is_empty() {
8909                                            self.parse_inline_udt_value(
8910                                                field_data,
8911                                                udt_name,
8912                                                inline_fields,
8913                                                1,
8914                                            )?
8915                                        } else {
8916                                            Value::Blob(field_data.to_vec())
8917                                        }
8918                                    }
8919                                    CqlType::Frozen(inner) => {
8920                                        // Handle FROZEN<udt_type> - the inner type may be a UDT
8921                                        match inner.as_ref() {
8922                                            CqlType::Custom(nested_type_name) => {
8923                                                // Issue #239: Handle "udt:" prefix from schema parsing
8924                                                let lookup_name = nested_type_name
8925                                                    .strip_prefix("udt:")
8926                                                    .unwrap_or(nested_type_name);
8927                                                if let Some(nested_udt) =
8928                                                    registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, lookup_name)
8929                                                {
8930                                                    let inner_value = self
8931                                                        .parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8932                                                            field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8933                                                        )?;
8934                                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8935                                                } else {
8936                                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(Value::Blob(
8937                                                        field_data.to_vec(),
8938                                                    )))
8939                                                }
8940                                            }
8941                                            CqlType::Udt(udt_name, inline_fields) => {
8942                                                // Prefer registry, fall back to inline fields (Issue #239)
8943                                                if let Some(nested_udt) =
8944                                                    registry.get_udt(&self.keyspace, udt_name)
8945                                                {
8946                                                    let inner_value = self
8947                                                        .parse_nested_udt_from_registry(
8948                                                            field_data, nested_udt, registry,
8949                                                        )?;
8950                                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8951                                                } else if !inline_fields.is_empty() {
8952                                                    let inner_value = self.parse_inline_udt_value(
8953                                                        field_data,
8954                                                        udt_name,
8955                                                        inline_fields,
8956                                                        1,
8957                                                    )?;
8958                                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8959                                                } else {
8960                                                    Value::Frozen(Box::new(Value::Blob(
8961                                                        field_data.to_vec(),
8962                                                    )))
8963                                                }
8964                                            }
8965                                            _ => {
8966                                                // Other frozen types - parse as simple value
8967                                                let inner_value =
8968                                                    Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8969                                                        field_data, inner,
8970                                                    )?;
8971                                                Value::Frozen(Box::new(inner_value))
8972                                            }
8973                                        }
8974                                    }
8975                                    _ => Self::parse_simple_udt_field_value(
8976                                        field_data,
8977                                        &field_def.field_type,
8978                                    )?,
8979                                };
8980                                Some(value)
8981                            };
8982
8983                            fields.push(UdtField {
8984                                name: field_def.name.clone(),
8985                                value: field_value,
8986                            });
8987                        }
8988
8989                        let udt_value = UdtValue {
8990                            type_name: udt_def.name.clone(),
8991                            keyspace: udt_def.keyspace.clone(),
8992                            fields,
8993                        };
8994
8995                        offset += current_offset;
8996                        Value::Udt(udt_value)
8997                    } else {
8998                        // Not found in registry - parse as blob
8999                        log::debug!(
9000                            "Frozen element '{}': unknown type '{}', parsing as blob",
9001                            column_name,
9002                            type_str
9003                        );
9004
9005                        let (remaining, blob_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
9006                            Error::corruption(format!(
9007                                "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse unknown type length as VInt: {:?}",
9008                                column_name, e
9009                            ))
9010                        })?;
9011                        let blob_len = blob_len as usize;
9012                        let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
9013                        offset += bytes_consumed;
9014
9015                        if offset + blob_len > data.len() {
9016                            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9017                                "Frozen element '{}': need {} bytes for unknown type, only {} available",
9018                                column_name,
9019                                blob_len,
9020                                data.len() - offset
9021                            )));
9022                        }
9023
9024                        let blob_bytes = data[offset..offset + blob_len].to_vec();
9025                        offset += blob_len;
9026                        Value::Blob(blob_bytes)
9027                    }
9028                } else {
9029                    // No registry available - parse as blob
9030                    log::debug!(
9031                        "Frozen element '{}': unknown type '{}', no UDT registry available, parsing as blob",
9032                        column_name,
9033                        type_str
9034                    );
9035
9036                    let (remaining, blob_len) = parse_vuint(&data[offset..]).map_err(|e| {
9037                        Error::corruption(format!(
9038                            "Frozen element '{}': failed to parse unknown type length as VInt: {:?}",
9039                            column_name, e
9040                        ))
9041                    })?;
9042                    let blob_len = blob_len as usize;
9043                    let bytes_consumed = data[offset..].len() - remaining.len();
9044                    offset += bytes_consumed;
9045
9046                    if offset + blob_len > data.len() {
9047                        return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9048                            "Frozen element '{}': need {} bytes for unknown type, only {} available",
9049                            column_name,
9050                            blob_len,
9051                            data.len() - offset
9052                        )));
9053                    }
9054
9055                    let blob_bytes = data[offset..offset + blob_len].to_vec();
9056                    offset += blob_len;
9057                    Value::Blob(blob_bytes)
9058                }
9059            }
9060        };
9061
9062        Ok((value, offset))
9063    }
9064
9065    /// Parse a cell path key (for map keys stored in cell paths).
9066    /// Cell path keys are stored as raw bytes WITHOUT length prefixes.
9067    fn parse_cell_path_key(&self, data: &[u8], type_str: &str, column_name: &str) -> Result<Value> {
9068        let normalized_type = type_str.to_lowercase();
9069
9070        match normalized_type.as_str() {
9071            // Text types: raw UTF-8 bytes (no length prefix)
9072            "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.utf8type"
9073            | "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.asciitype"
9074            | "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.varchartype"
9075            | "text"
9076            | "varchar"
9077            | "ascii" => {
9078                let text = String::from_utf8(data.to_vec())
9079                    .map_err(|e| Error::corruption(format!("Invalid UTF-8 in map key: {}", e)))?;
9080                Ok(Value::Text(text))
9081            }
9082
9083            // UUID types: 16 bytes
9084            "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.uuidtype"
9085            | "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.timeuuidtype"
9086            | "uuid"
9087            | "timeuuid" => {
9088                if data.len() != 16 {
9089                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9090                        "Map key UUID requires 16 bytes, got {}",
9091                        data.len()
9092                    )));
9093                }
9094                let uuid_bytes: [u8; 16] = data[0..16]
9095                    .try_into()
9096                    .map_err(|_| Error::corruption("UUID byte conversion failed"))?;
9097                Ok(Value::Uuid(uuid_bytes))
9098            }
9099
9100            // Int types: 4 bytes big-endian
9101            "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.int32type" | "int" => {
9102                if data.len() != 4 {
9103                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9104                        "Map key int requires 4 bytes, got {}",
9105                        data.len()
9106                    )));
9107                }
9108                let v = i32::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
9109                Ok(Value::Integer(v))
9110            }
9111
9112            // BigInt types: 8 bytes big-endian
9113            "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.longtype" | "bigint" | "counter" => {
9114                if data.len() != 8 {
9115                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9116                        "Map key bigint requires 8 bytes, got {}",
9117                        data.len()
9118                    )));
9119                }
9120                let v = i64::from_be_bytes([
9121                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
9122                ]);
9123                Ok(Value::BigInt(v))
9124            }
9125
9126            // Date types: 4 bytes (days since epoch with Integer.MIN_VALUE offset)
9127            "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.simpledatetype" | "date" => {
9128                if data.len() != 4 {
9129                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9130                        "Map key date requires 4 bytes, got {}",
9131                        data.len()
9132                    )));
9133                }
9134                // Cassandra DATE: 4-byte unsigned int with Integer.MIN_VALUE offset
9135                let stored = u32::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
9136                let days_since_epoch = stored.wrapping_add(i32::MIN as u32) as i32;
9137                Ok(Value::Date(days_since_epoch))
9138            }
9139
9140            // Timestamp types: 8 bytes (milliseconds since epoch)
9141            "org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.timestamptype" | "timestamp" => {
9142                if data.len() != 8 {
9143                    return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9144                        "Map key timestamp requires 8 bytes, got {}",
9145                        data.len()
9146                    )));
9147                }
9148                let millis = i64::from_be_bytes([
9149                    data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3], data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7],
9150                ]);
9151                Ok(Value::Timestamp(millis))
9152            }
9153
9154            // Fallback: return as blob
9155            _ => {
9156                log::debug!(
9157                    "Map key type '{}' for column '{}' parsed as blob ({} bytes)",
9158                    type_str,
9159                    column_name,
9160                    data.len()
9161                );
9162                Ok(Value::Blob(data.to_vec()))
9163            }
9164        }
9165    }
9166
9167    /// Read i32 BE element/entry count from a frozen collection blob.
9168    ///
9169    /// `bound` is the exclusive upper byte index for the collection data (either
9170    /// `data.len()` for raw variants or `blob_end` for cell-level variants).
9171    fn read_frozen_count(
9172        data: &[u8],
9173        offset: &mut usize,
9174        bound: usize,
9175        collection_kind: &str,
9176        column_name: &str,
9177    ) -> Result<usize> {
9178        if *offset + 4 > bound {
9179            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9180                "Frozen {} '{}': not enough bytes for element count",
9181                collection_kind, column_name
9182            )));
9183        }
9184        let count = i32::from_be_bytes([
9185            data[*offset],
9186            data[*offset + 1],
9187            data[*offset + 2],
9188            data[*offset + 3],
9189        ]);
9190        *offset += 4;
9191
9192        if count < 0 {
9193            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9194                "Frozen {} '{}': negative element count {}",
9195                collection_kind, column_name, count
9196            )));
9197        }
9198        let count = count as usize;
9199        if count > MAX_FROZEN_COLLECTION_SIZE as usize {
9200            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9201                "Frozen {} '{}': element count {} exceeds maximum {}",
9202                collection_kind, column_name, count, MAX_FROZEN_COLLECTION_SIZE
9203            )));
9204        }
9205        Ok(count)
9206    }
9207
9208    /// Read the frozen collection preamble: VUInt blob_len + i32 BE element count.
9209    ///
9210    /// Returns `(count, blob_end)` with `offset` advanced past the preamble.
9211    fn read_frozen_preamble(
9212        data: &[u8],
9213        offset: &mut usize,
9214        collection_kind: &str,
9215        column_name: &str,
9216    ) -> Result<(usize, usize)> {
9217        let (remaining, blob_len) = parse_vuint(&data[*offset..]).map_err(|e| {
9218            Error::corruption(format!(
9219                "Frozen {} '{}': failed to parse blob length: {:?}",
9220                collection_kind, column_name, e
9221            ))
9222        })?;
9223        let blob_len = blob_len as usize;
9224        let bytes_consumed = data[*offset..].len() - remaining.len();
9225        *offset += bytes_consumed;
9226
9227        if *offset + blob_len > data.len() {
9228            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9229                "Frozen {} '{}': blob_len {} exceeds available data {}",
9230                collection_kind,
9231                column_name,
9232                blob_len,
9233                data.len() - *offset
9234            )));
9235        }
9236
9237        let blob_end = *offset + blob_len;
9238        let count = Self::read_frozen_count(data, offset, blob_end, collection_kind, column_name)?;
9239        Ok((count, blob_end))
9240    }
9241
9242    /// Read a single length-prefixed element from a frozen collection blob.
9243    ///
9244    /// `blob_end` is the exclusive upper byte index bounding the collection.
9245    /// `element_desc` appears in error messages (e.g. `"list 'col' element 3"`).
9246    fn read_frozen_element(
9247        &self,
9248        data: &[u8],
9249        offset: &mut usize,
9250        blob_end: usize,
9251        type_str: &str,
9252        element_desc: &str,
9253        depth: usize,
9254    ) -> Result<Value> {
9255        if *offset + 4 > blob_end {
9256            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9257                "Frozen {}: not enough bytes for length",
9258                element_desc
9259            )));
9260        }
9261        let len_i32 = i32::from_be_bytes([
9262            data[*offset],
9263            data[*offset + 1],
9264            data[*offset + 2],
9265            data[*offset + 3],
9266        ]);
9267        if len_i32 < 0 {
9268            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9269                "Frozen {}: negative length {}",
9270                element_desc, len_i32
9271            )));
9272        }
9273        let len = len_i32 as usize;
9274        *offset += 4;
9275
9276        if *offset + len > blob_end {
9277            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9278                "Frozen {}: needs {} bytes but only {} available",
9279                element_desc,
9280                len,
9281                blob_end - *offset
9282            )));
9283        }
9284
9285        let elem_data = &data[*offset..*offset + len];
9286        let value = self.parse_value_from_raw_bytes(elem_data, type_str, element_desc, depth)?;
9287        *offset += len;
9288        Ok(value)
9289    }
9290
9291    /// Parse a frozen list or set (cell-level, with VUInt blob_len prefix).
9292    ///
9293    /// The cell layout on disk is:
9294    ///   [VUInt blob_len][i32 BE element_count][i32 BE elem_len][elem_bytes]...
9295    ///
9296    /// `as_set = true` wraps the result in `Value::Set`; otherwise `Value::List`.
9297    fn parse_frozen_sequence_value(
9298        &self,
9299        data: &[u8],
9300        mut offset: usize,
9301        element_type: &str,
9302        column: &crate::schema::Column,
9303        as_set: bool,
9304    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
9305        let kind = if as_set { "set" } else { "list" };
9306        let (count, blob_end) = Self::read_frozen_preamble(data, &mut offset, kind, &column.name)?;
9307
9308        log::debug!(
9309            "V5CompressedLegacy: Frozen {} '{}' with {} elements, element_type='{}'",
9310            kind,
9311            column.name,
9312            count,
9313            element_type
9314        );
9315
9316        let mut elements = Vec::with_capacity(count);
9317        for i in 0..count {
9318            let desc = format!("{} '{}' element {}", kind, column.name, i);
9319            let value =
9320                self.read_frozen_element(data, &mut offset, blob_end, element_type, &desc, 0)?;
9321            log::debug!(
9322                "V5CompressedLegacy: Frozen {} element {}: {:?}",
9323                kind,
9324                i,
9325                value
9326            );
9327            elements.push(value);
9328        }
9329
9330        if as_set {
9331            Ok((Value::Set(elements), blob_end))
9332        } else {
9333            Ok((Value::List(elements), blob_end))
9334        }
9335    }
9336
9337    /// Parse frozen list value (thin wrapper around `parse_frozen_sequence_value`).
9338    fn parse_frozen_list_value(
9339        &self,
9340        data: &[u8],
9341        offset: usize,
9342        element_type: &str,
9343        column: &crate::schema::Column,
9344        _reader: &super::super::types::SSTableReader,
9345    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
9346        self.parse_frozen_sequence_value(data, offset, element_type, column, false)
9347    }
9348
9349    /// Parse frozen set value (thin wrapper around `parse_frozen_sequence_value`).
9350    ///
9351    /// Frozen sets have the same binary format as frozen lists; the distinction
9352    /// is semantic (sets are sorted/unique at the CQL level).
9353    fn parse_frozen_set_value(
9354        &self,
9355        data: &[u8],
9356        offset: usize,
9357        element_type: &str,
9358        column: &crate::schema::Column,
9359        _reader: &super::super::types::SSTableReader,
9360    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
9361        self.parse_frozen_sequence_value(data, offset, element_type, column, true)
9362    }
9363
9364    /// Parse frozen map value.
9365    ///
9366    /// The cell layout on disk is:
9367    ///   [VUInt blob_len][i32 BE entry_count][i32 BE key_len][key_bytes][i32 BE val_len][val_bytes]...
9368    fn parse_frozen_map_value(
9369        &self,
9370        data: &[u8],
9371        mut offset: usize,
9372        key_type: &str,
9373        value_type: &str,
9374        column: &crate::schema::Column,
9375        _reader: &super::super::types::SSTableReader,
9376    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
9377        let (count, blob_end) = Self::read_frozen_preamble(data, &mut offset, "map", &column.name)?;
9378
9379        log::debug!(
9380            "V5CompressedLegacy: Frozen map '{}' with {} entries, key_type='{}', value_type='{}'",
9381            column.name,
9382            count,
9383            key_type,
9384            value_type
9385        );
9386
9387        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(count);
9388        for i in 0..count {
9389            let key_desc = format!("map '{}' key {}", column.name, i);
9390            let key_value =
9391                self.read_frozen_element(data, &mut offset, blob_end, key_type, &key_desc, 0)?;
9392
9393            let val_desc = format!("map '{}' value {}", column.name, i);
9394            let val_value =
9395                self.read_frozen_element(data, &mut offset, blob_end, value_type, &val_desc, 0)?;
9396
9397            log::debug!(
9398                "V5CompressedLegacy: Frozen map entry {}: {:?} -> {:?}",
9399                i,
9400                key_value,
9401                val_value
9402            );
9403            entries.push((key_value, val_value));
9404        }
9405
9406        Ok((Value::Map(entries), blob_end))
9407    }
9408
9409    /// Parse a frozen list or set (raw, nested inside an already-bounded blob).
9410    ///
9411    /// Called when parsing nested collections inside an already-bounded frozen
9412    /// blob.  There is NO VUInt cell-value-length prefix — the caller has
9413    /// already bounded the data slice.  `as_set = true` produces `Value::Set`.
9414    fn parse_frozen_sequence_value_raw(
9415        &self,
9416        data: &[u8],
9417        mut offset: usize,
9418        element_type: &str,
9419        column_name: &str,
9420        as_set: bool,
9421        depth: usize,
9422    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
9423        let kind = if as_set { "set" } else { "list" };
9424        let count = Self::read_frozen_count(data, &mut offset, data.len(), kind, column_name)?;
9425
9426        log::debug!(
9427            "V5CompressedLegacy: Parsing frozen {} '{}' with {} elements (raw)",
9428            kind,
9429            column_name,
9430            count
9431        );
9432
9433        let mut elements = Vec::with_capacity(count);
9434        for i in 0..count {
9435            // Each element in a frozen collection: [i32 BE len][element bytes]
9436            if offset + 4 > data.len() {
9437                return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9438                    "Frozen {} '{}': not enough bytes for element {} length",
9439                    kind, column_name, i
9440                )));
9441            }
9442            let elem_len_i32 = i32::from_be_bytes([
9443                data[offset],
9444                data[offset + 1],
9445                data[offset + 2],
9446                data[offset + 3],
9447            ]);
9448            if elem_len_i32 < 0 {
9449                return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9450                    "Frozen {} '{}': negative element {} length {}",
9451                    kind, column_name, i, elem_len_i32
9452                )));
9453            }
9454            let elem_len = elem_len_i32 as usize;
9455            offset += 4;
9456
9457            if offset + elem_len > data.len() {
9458                return Err(Error::corruption(format!(
9459                    "Frozen {} '{}': element {} needs {} bytes but only {} available",
9460                    kind,
9461                    column_name,
9462                    i,
9463                    elem_len,
9464                    data.len() - offset
9465                )));
9466            }
9467
9468            let elem_data = &data[offset..offset + elem_len];
9469            let elem_value =
9470                self.parse_value_from_raw_bytes(elem_data, element_type, column_name, depth)?;
9471            elements.push(elem_value);
9472            offset += elem_len;
9473        }
9474
9475        if as_set {
9476            Ok((Value::Set(elements), offset))
9477        } else {
9478            Ok((Value::List(elements), offset))
9479        }
9480    }
9481
9482    /// Parse frozen list value (raw version without Column parameter).
9483    fn parse_frozen_list_value_raw(
9484        &self,
9485        data: &[u8],
9486        offset: usize,
9487        element_type: &str,
9488        column_name: &str,
9489        depth: usize,
9490    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
9491        self.parse_frozen_sequence_value_raw(data, offset, element_type, column_name, false, depth)
9492    }
9493
9494    /// Parse frozen set value (raw version without Column parameter).
9495    fn parse_frozen_set_value_raw(
9496        &self,
9497        data: &[u8],
9498        offset: usize,
9499        element_type: &str,
9500        column_name: &str,
9501        depth: usize,
9502    ) -> Result<(Value, usize)> {
9503        self.parse_frozen_sequence_value_raw(data, offset, element_type, column_name, true, depth)
9504    }
